See [Errors and statuses](https://ivoracharge.co/developers/guides/reference/errors).

get.summary: Read the project's CSMS usage fee and its team's payment method
get.description: Requires billing:read, or a signed-in member whose team role manages billing (owner, admin, billing). Billing is per team (company): the team owns the payment method, waiver, grace period and the monthly invoice, with a line per project. Ivora charges a usage fee per kWh of charging (rate_cents_per_kwh: the project's override, else the team's rate, default 1.00 cent). status payment_method_required means new CSMS setup and control answer 402 payment_method_required until the team adds a card; teams of tenants that existed before the fee have a grace period (grace_ends_at). current_month is the project's share of this UTC month's invoice so far, by the invoice's rule (completed sessions, kWh as a decimal string, billed from billable_from, the project's line and then the team's discount, in cents; invoiced false for internal, bench, waived or grace usage), cached up to 60 seconds; null when the CSMS cannot be read. The team's whole month is .../billing-profile/usage. Reads never call Stripe.

post.summary: Start adding or replacing the team's payment method
post.description: Signed-in tenant-admin of the project (and so of any project of the team) or Ivora staff; API keys are refused. Returns a Stripe-hosted setup page on Ivora's own Stripe account that saves a card for the project's team without charging it; it returns to the Platform's billing page (server-selected). Call the sync endpoint afterwards. Each call returns a new page; a card saved there replaces the team's current one for all of its projects.

post.summary: Record the payment method saved on the setup page
post.description: Signed-in tenant-admin or Ivora staff; API keys are refused. Reads the setup page's outcome and the team customer's default card from Stripe and records its summary (brand, last4, expiry). A replaced card is removed from Stripe. Safe to repeat.

delete.description: Signed-in tenant-admin or Ivora staff; API keys are refused. Removes the team's card from Ivora's Stripe account, for every project of the team. Without a card (and outside a grace period, waiver or exemption) the team's projects answer 402 payment_method_required to new CSMS setup and control: see [Errors and statuses](https://ivoracharge.co/developers/guides/reference/errors).

get.summary: List the team's monthly usage-fee invoices
get.description: Requires billing:read, or a signed-in member whose team role manages billing (owner, admin, billing). One invoice per team (company) and month with a line per project: the kWh of the projects' charging sessions that ended in the month (UTC), every settlement type, times the project's rate. hosted_invoice_url is Stripe's page to view or pay it. A month below Stripe's 50-cent minimum, or without a card on file, is carried to the next month. Newest first.

get.summary: Estimate the team's usage fee for the current month
get.description: Requires billing:read, or a signed-in member whose team role manages billing (owner, admin, billing). The team's projects' kWh so far this month (sessions that ended), their rates, and the amount the month's invoice would have now, plus any balance carried from an earlier month. An estimate: the invoice is made after the month ends (UTC). Reads the CSMS, never Stripe.

get.summary: Read the team's billing account
get.description: The team's owners, admins and billing members (billing:manage), and Ivora staff; API keys are refused. The team's usage-fee status, card on file, grace period, discount and every project with its rate and current_month (the project's usage so far this UTC month and its estimated fee, null when the CSMS cannot be read). A project limit does not narrow it: billing is the team's as a whole. Reads never call Stripe.

post.summary: Start adding or replacing the team's payment method
post.description: The team's owners, admins and billing members, and Ivora administrators; API keys are refused. Returns a Stripe-hosted setup page on Ivora's own Stripe account that saves a card for the team without charging it, returning to the Platform's billing page (server-selected). Call .../payment-method/sync afterwards. A card saved there replaces the team's current one for every project.

post.summary: Record the payment method saved on the setup page
post.description: The team's owners, admins and billing members, and Ivora administrators; API keys are refused. Reads the setup page's outcome and the team's default card from Stripe and records its summary. A replaced card is removed. Safe to repeat.

delete.description: The team's owners, admins and billing members, and Ivora administrators; API keys are refused. Without a card (and outside a grace period, waiver or exemption) the team's projects answer 402 payment_method_required to new CSMS setup and control: see [Errors and statuses](https://ivoracharge.co/developers/guides/reference/errors).

post.summary: Connect the team's bank account for enterprise invoices
post.description: Enterprise teams only (409 otherwise). The team's owners, admins and billing members, and Ivora administrators; API keys are refused. Returns a Stripe-hosted page on Ivora's own Stripe account that connects and verifies a bank account (ACH Direct Debit for bank_country us, Canadian pre-authorized debit in USD, from a USD account, for ca) and accepts the debit mandate, returning to the Platform's billing page. Call .../bank-account/sync afterwards. A verified account is debited on each invoice's due date.

post.summary: Record the bank account connected on the setup page
post.description: The team's owners, admins and billing members, and Ivora administrators; API keys are refused. bank_account.status is verified, or pending_verification until the microdeposits Stripe sent are confirmed (Stripe's event then records it). Safe to repeat.

delete.description: The team's owners, admins and billing members, and Ivora administrators; API keys are refused. Ends the debit mandate; enterprise invoices are then paid by bank transfer (or card when allowed) by their due date.

get.summary: List the team's monthly usage-fee invoices
get.description: The team's owners, admins and billing members, and Ivora staff; API keys are refused. One invoice per month with a line per project, newest first; hosted_invoice_url is Stripe's page to view or pay it. The same list as GET /v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/billing-profile/invoices for any of the team's projects.

get.summary: Estimate the team's usage fee for the current month
get.description: The team's owners, admins and billing members, and Ivora staff; API keys are refused. Every project's kWh so far this month (sessions that ended), its rate and line, the team's discount and any balance carried from an earlier month: what the month's invoice would be now. An estimate: the invoice is made after the month ends (UTC). Reads the CSMS, never Stripe.

get.summary: List your teams, their projects and your role
get.description: Every team you belong to with your team role, team permissions and the projects (tenants) your role reaches, each with its scopes; plus pending invites to your confirmed email and your Ivora staff roles, if any. Staff reach every team through their platform roles, which are not listed as memberships.

post.summary: Create a team
post.description: Any signed-in user; you become its owner. A team holds projects, members and its own payment method. You create at most 5 teams (409 team_limit). CSMS access: the team inherits it when you own a team with CSMS access in good standing (a card on file, nothing overdue, not suspended), for up to 5 such teams; otherwise it starts without CSMS access (Data Tools only) until Ivora enables it, and creating projects answers 403 csms_not_enabled. Either way the team adds its own payment method before new CSMS setup and control. Replays with the same Idempotency-Key return the same team. Errors: 409 team_limit. See [Errors and statuses](https://ivoracharge.co/developers/guides/reference/errors).

get.summary: Read the team's self-serve CSMS trial status
get.description: Any member of the team, and Ivora staff: whether the team may enable CSMS access itself (a usable card on file), its place in the trial or on the waitlist, its charger cap and usage, and the features that wait for Ivora's review.

post.summary: Enable CSMS access yourself (self-serve trial)
post.description: Where Ivora has opened the self-serve trial (off in production until Ivora opens it; where it is not open this answers 409 self_serve_unavailable: ask Ivora for CSMS access instead): the team's owner only, with a confirmed email, once the team has a usable card on file (billing status active: not expired, nothing overdue, not suspended), turns on the team's CSMS access without a meeting or an Ivora grant. It turns on right away (enabled_via self_serve), with at most 10 chargers across the team's projects, rate-limited commands and writes, and OCPI publishing, custom OCPP, payment and QR domains and enterprise invoicing waiting for Ivora's review. The trial takes a limited number of teams; once it is full the team joins the waitlist in order (outcome waitlisted) and enrolling again later takes a place that has opened. An owner has one trial team: while another team they own is in the trial or on its waitlist and Ivora has not reviewed it, enrolling answers 409 self_serve_not_eligible (details.reason owner_has_trial). Calling it again when nothing changed answers outcome unchanged. Errors: 409 self_serve_not_eligible, 409 self_serve_unavailable. See [Errors and statuses](https://ivoracharge.co/developers/guides/reference/errors).

post.summary: Ask Ivora to review a self-serve team
post.description: Owners and admins: ask Ivora to lift the charger cap and the review gates (more chargers, OCPI publishing, custom domains, enterprise invoicing), with an optional note. Ivora is told; asking again keeps the first request.

get.summary: List pending invites to your email

post.summary: Join a team you were invited to
post.description: Only the user whose confirmed email the invite names may accept it. 410 invite_expired after 14 days; 409 already_member or invite_closed (accepted, declined or revoked).

post.summary: Decline an invite

get.summary: List a team's members
get.description: Any member of the team, and Ivora staff.

patch.summary: Change a member's role or project limit
patch.description: Owners and admins (members:manage) and Ivora administrators. Only an owner grants, changes or removes the owner role; a team keeps at least one owner (409 last_owner). Owners and admins are never limited to projects.

delete.summary: Remove a member, or leave a team
delete.description: Owners and admins remove members (only an owner removes an owner); any member may remove themselves. The last owner stays.

get.summary: List a team's invites

post.summary: Invite someone by email
post.description: Owners and admins (only an owner invites an owner). The invite is bound to the email: the person signs in with that confirmed email and accepts it from GET /v1/me/teams. Ivora sends no email; share the sign-in link yourself. Expires after 14 days. 409 already_member or invite_pending.

get.summary: Read Ivora's current terms
get.description: The current version of Ivora's Terms of Service and data processing addendum: each is Common Paper Standard Terms (linked, CC BY 4.0) incorporated by an Ivora Cover Page, given with its text (Markdown) and SHA-256. A team owner accepts both before the team turns on self-serve CSMS access, and again after a new major or minor version.

get.summary: Read a team's acceptance of Ivora's terms
get.description: Any member of the team, and Ivora staff. Whether the team accepted the current version of every document, which ones an owner still has to accept, and every acceptance with who accepted, when and which version. The client address and user agent are shown to the team's owners and admins and to staff only.

post.summary: Accept Ivora's terms for a team
post.description: Team owners only. Send each document with the Standard Terms and cover page versions you showed in full (GET /v1/legal/terms); the acceptance records you, your team role, the time, both versions and the cover page's SHA-256, your client address and user agent. A version that is no longer current is refused: show the new text and accept that. Accepting a version again keeps the first record (outcome unchanged). Errors: 409 terms_version_outdated. See [Errors and statuses](https://ivoracharge.co/developers/guides/reference/errors).

get.summary: List the project's API keys
get.description: Every key the project owns, whoever created it, newest first; never the secrets. The team's owners, admins and developers (keys:manage) and Ivora staff.

post.summary: Create an API key owned by the project
post.description: The team's owners, admins and developers reaching the project (keys:manage), and Ivora administrators. The key belongs to the project: it is allowed exactly its scopes here and keeps working when the person who made it leaves the team, until revoked. Project scopes only, each one you hold on the project, and migration:import (the project's network imports, POST /v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/imports), which only the team's owners and admins and Ivora administrators grant (developers get 403 forbidden). The secret is returned once. A project keeps 20 active keys. Errors: 402 billing_suspended, 402 payment_method_required. See [Errors and statuses](https://ivoracharge.co/developers/guides/reference/errors).

delete.description: The team's owners, admins and developers, and Ivora administrators. The project's charger proxy key (migration:proxy): the team's owners and admins and Ivora administrators only; developers get 403 forbidden. Audited as project.api_key.revoked (GET /v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/audit). Takes effect on the key's next request.

post.summary: Create a project in a team
post.description: The team's owners and admins (projects:manage) and Ivora administrators. A project is a new charging tenant of the team: owners and admins reach it at once, project-limited members once a manager adds it to their projects. The team needs CSMS access (403 csms_not_enabled otherwise). The team's payment method, discount and grace period cover it. A team holds at most 50 projects (409 project_limit). default_currency (USD unless sent) is the project's default currency, one of GET /v1/currencies. metadata sets the project's own key/value pairs. Replays with the same Idempotency-Key return the same project.

get.summary: Read a project's name and team
get.description: Anyone with access to the project, including an API key bound to it.

patch.summary: Rename a project or change its metadata
patch.description: The team's owners and admins (projects:manage) and Ivora administrators. name changes the charging tenant's name everywhere it is shown; its ID, chargers and keys are unchanged. default_currency changes the project's default currency (one of GET /v1/currencies); existing tariffs and bills keep theirs. Once the project has a Stripe account (connected or pinned), its default_currency can only be the account's own currency (409 currency_locked_by_account), and an account that takes no supported currency refuses every change (409 account_currency_unsupported); Ivora staff may override both, and the audit entry records the override. The same value again is a no-op. currency_display picks how charger screens and running cost show money (symbol: CA$0.35, code: $0.35 CAD). metadata merges into the project's metadata (a key sent as "" or null is deleted). checkout_domain picks which of the project's active payment domains checkout links and QR codes use, qr_domain which of its active QR domains new stickers encode (sticker_url_template shows the result); null returns to Ivora's default, whose checkout URLs keep working for every project. A domain without an active, ready certificate is refused (409 domain_certificate_inactive); each change is audited (project.checkout_domain_changed, project.qr_domain_changed). Errors: 409 account_currency_unsupported, 409 currency_locked_by_account, 409 domain_certificate_inactive, 422 domain_not_in_project, 422 metadata_key_invalid, 422 metadata_too_many_keys, 422 metadata_value_invalid. See [Errors and statuses](https://ivoracharge.co/developers/guides/reference/errors).

post.summary: Register an app for a team
post.description: The team's owners, admins and developers, and Ivora administrators. An app is private: only the team's own projects can install it. It declares its UI origins and extensions (where the dashboard shows it), the scopes it requests, and a webhook URL. Each UI origin must be https://<app>.<apps domain>, one label of 1-63 characters with no port (ivoraapps.com in production; 422 app_origin_outside_apps_domain), and never on Ivora's own domains (422 app_origin_refused). Apps may request stations:control, billing:write and tariffs:write, which installers must consent to; never billing:refund or stations:admin (422 app_scope_forbidden). The client_secret is returned once. A team registers at most 50 apps. Only Ivora administrators register an app as visibility first_party (403 otherwise): Ivora's own app, which every project can install and the dashboard shows as made by Ivora (publisher Ivora).

get.summary: List a team's apps
get.description: Any member of the team and Ivora staff. Archived apps are not listed; never the client secret.

get.summary: Read a team's app

patch.description: Changing the scopes, UI origins or extensions raises the app's revision, so a consent given earlier cannot be reused (409 consent_outdated). Only Ivora administrators change visibility, each change in the team's audit trail; a first_party app's webhook_url and ui_origins change only by Ivora administrators (403 app_first_party_staff_only), each change in the audit trail with before and after; back to private is refused while the app is installed outside the team (409 app_installed_outside_team). Narrowing the requested scopes removes them from every install at once; widening them grants nothing until an installer consents again. A developer limited to some projects is refused (403) while the app is installed in a project outside them.

delete.summary: Archive an app and revoke all its installs
delete.description: Every install of the app, in every project, is revoked at once (revoked_reason app_archived). The app cannot be installed again. Owners, admins and Ivora administrators; a project-limited developer only when every active install is in their projects.

post.summary: Rotate an app's client secret
post.description: The old secret stops working at once; for a first_party app only Ivora administrators rotate it (403 app_first_party_staff_only); the new one is returned once. Refused (403) to a project-limited developer while any project outside their limit has the app installed.

post.summary: Issue an app's webhook signing key
post.description: Replaces the key that signs the app's lifecycle events (app.installed, app.uninstalled, app.scopes_changed); for a first_party app only Ivora administrators issue it (403 app_first_party_staff_only); the new one is returned once. Apps registered before webhooks existed have none and receive no events until one is issued. Refused (403) to a project-limited developer while any project outside their limit has the app installed.

get.summary: List an app's lifecycle events and their delivery
get.description: Oldest first after the after cursor (an event sequence). Events go to the app's webhook_url as signed POSTs (Ivora-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex HMAC-SHA256 of '<t>.<body>'> with the webhook secret), retried with backoff for about a day, at least once: deduplicate by event id. For a project-limited developer only their projects' events, and only when the app is active in none outside them.

get.summary: List an app's installs across the team's projects
get.description: Revoked installs are included, for a project-limited developer only in their projects, and only when the app is active in none outside them.

get.summary: List the apps a project can install
get.description: The project's team's active apps and every first_party app (Ivora's own), each with its active install here. Anyone with access to the project. A first_party app of another team is shown without its secret_prefix, created_by or webhook_url.

get.summary: Read what installing an app would grant
get.description: The consent screen's data: the scopes the app requests (sensitive ones flagged: stations:control, billing:write, tariffs:write, settlement:write), the per-install rate limit and the revision to send back when installing.

post.summary: Install an app in a project
post.description: A team owner, admin or developer of the project, and Ivora administrators; another team's first_party app only the project team's owners and admins (403 for a developer). Send the scopes you accept (a subset of the app's request, each one you hold yourself) and the consent_revision from the consent view. 409 consent_outdated when the app changed since; 409 app_already_installed. An Ivora administrator outside the project's team installs only on the project's request and sends a reason (422 staff_reason_required without it), kept as the install's staff_reason; every install is recorded in the project's audit trail (app.installed).

get.summary: List a project's app installs
get.description: Active and revoked installs, oldest first. Anyone with access to the project.

get.summary: Read an app install

patch.summary: Change an install's scopes or rate limit
patch.description: Scopes are replaced with a fresh consent (scopes and consent_revision). Only Ivora administrators change rate_limit_per_minute (default 120 requests a minute for each install).

delete.description: A team owner, admin or developer of the project, and Ivora administrators. Revokes everything the install held at once; repeating it returns the revoked install.

post.summary: Get a session token for an installed app
post.description: For the dashboard to hand to an app's UI (getAccessToken). A signed-in member of the project's team asks for a token for an active install. It lasts 5 minutes; its scopes are the install's consented scopes within what your team role in the project allows, and never an Ivora staff role: a staff member who is not in the team gets 403. The app's UI origins may call /v1 with it from the browser (CORS), and its backend verifies it with /v1/apps/jwks.json and exchanges it at /v1/oauth/token. API keys, connected apps and app tokens cannot ask for one. 409 consent_outdated when the app added a UI origin since the install was consented to.

get.summary: Public keys that verify app tokens
get.description: The JSON Web Key Set (ES256) of the keys Ivora signs session and access tokens with. No credential is needed; cache it for a few minutes and refetch on an unknown kid.

post.summary: Exchange a session token or use client credentials
post.description: For an app's backend, which authenticates as the app with its client_id (the app's id) and client_secret, by HTTP Basic or in the body. Send application/x-www-form-urlencoded. grant_type urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:token-exchange with a subject_token (a session token for this app) returns a 10 minute access token for the same user, install and project, never wider; grant_type client_credentials with install_id returns the install's own token, with no user. Optional scope narrows either. Errors use the RFC 6749 body {error, error_description}.

get.summary: Read the audit log you may see
get.description: Everything you are allowed to read across teams: the entries of the teams you own or administer (members, invites and all their projects) and of projects where you manage API keys (owners, admins and developers). Ivora staff read every entry. Optional team_id and tenant_id narrow it. Filters: action (an exact action or a family, such as team.member), actor, since (inclusive) and until (exclusive), ISO 8601 timestamps with an offset. Newest first; page with cursor=next_cursor. Entries are append-only and hold no secrets.

parameters.name: cursor

schema.description: next_cursor of the previous page.
schema.title: Cursor

parameters.description: next_cursor of the previous page.

get.summary: Read a project's audit log
get.description: Entries about the project: its renaming, API keys and other project changes. Owners, admins and developers of the project's team (keys:manage) and Ivora staff. Filters: action (an exact action or a family, such as team.member), actor, since (inclusive) and until (exclusive), ISO 8601 timestamps with an offset. Newest first; page with cursor=next_cursor. Entries are append-only and hold no secrets.

parameters.name: cursor

schema.description: next_cursor of the previous page.
schema.title: Cursor

parameters.description: next_cursor of the previous page.

get.summary: Read a team's audit log
get.description: Entries about the team's members and invites, and every entry of its projects. The team's owners and admins (members:manage) and Ivora staff. Filters: action (an exact action or a family, such as team.member), actor, since (inclusive) and until (exclusive), ISO 8601 timestamps with an offset. Newest first; page with cursor=next_cursor. Entries are append-only and hold no secrets.

parameters.name: cursor

schema.description: next_cursor of the previous page.
schema.title: Cursor

parameters.description: next_cursor of the previous page.

get.summary: Read an authorization request for the consent page
get.description: The app asking for access, the scopes it requested, the projects you can grant (with the project scopes you hold) and whether write scopes need a step-up sign-in. The first signed-in user to open a request owns it; others get 404. Read-only scopes are the default selection; write scopes and stations:admin are opt-in. Errors: 404 oauth_request_not_found, 410 oauth_request_expired. See [Errors and statuses](https://ivoracharge.co/developers/guides/reference/errors).

post.summary: Approve an authorization request
post.description: Grants the app the chosen scopes on one project and returns redirect_to, the app's redirect URI with a single-use code, for the browser to open. The scopes must be project scopes you hold on that project. Approving again for the same app and project replaces your earlier grant. Where write scopes need a step-up sign-in, a write scope without a fresh aal2 session is refused with step_up_required. Errors: 403, 403 step_up_required, 404 oauth_request_not_found, 410 oauth_request_expired, 422. See [Errors and statuses](https://ivoracharge.co/developers/guides/reference/errors).

post.summary: Decline an authorization request
post.description: Returns redirect_to, the app's redirect URI with error access_denied. Errors: 404 oauth_request_not_found, 410 oauth_request_expired. See [Errors and statuses](https://ivoracharge.co/developers/guides/reference/errors).

get.summary: List the apps connected to your account
get.description: Your active grants, newest first: the app, the project, the scopes, when you granted it, when it expires and its last use (updated at most once a minute).

delete.description: Revokes the grant: its access and refresh tokens stop working at once. Errors: 404 connected_app_not_found. See [Errors and statuses](https://ivoracharge.co/developers/guides/reference/errors).

get.summary: List the apps connected to a project
get.description: Every member's active grants on the project, with who granted them and their last use. For those who manage the project's API keys (team owners, admins and developers) and Ivora staff.

delete.summary: Disconnect an app from a project
delete.description: Revokes any member's grant on the project: its tokens stop working at once. Errors: 404 connected_app_not_found. See [Errors and statuses](https://ivoracharge.co/developers/guides/reference/errors).

get.summary: Read the project's connected-app audit log
get.description: Newest first: consent_granted, token_issued, token_refreshed, token_revoked, grant_revoked, refresh_reuse_detected and code_reuse_detected, with the app, the grant and the actor. Never a token. Page with before (a sequence).

get.summary: List where a test session's charger may connect
get.description: 409 bench_unavailable where this environment has no bench. The global endpoint, and with tenant_id that project's own options: its per-project charger URL, each of its custom OCPP domains (available once ready) and custom_url (signed-in members with stations:write; a third-party system). Pass one id as target.id when starting a session. Requires stations:read on the project.

get.summary: List the workspace's test sessions
get.description: Newest first. The session holding a bench charger reports live state; the others their stored bill.

post.summary: Start a test session on a bench charger
post.description: Leases a free OCPP bench charger (one per workspace), plugs in its simulated EV, creates a bill on the bench tenant, authorizes it and starts charging through the bill start path. 409 lease_active when the workspace already holds a charger; 409 pool_exhausted with Retry-After when every charger is leased; 409 bench_unavailable where this environment has no bench. Retry with the same Idempotency-Key to continue an interrupted start. target (GET /v1/sessions/targets) connects the charger through the project's per-project URL, one of its ready custom OCPP domains or a custom URL instead (stations:write on target.tenant_id; custom URLs for signed-in users only, one active lease each, 10 starts per hour, audited): a connection session, status connecting then connected or connect_failed with target.error; nothing is billed on the bench and charging is driven from that system. Runs on an EVerest charger of the OCPP bench through real OCPP: never a physical charger at a site, never live Stripe.

get.summary: Read a test session's live charging state
get.description: Charger state, transaction ID, energy_wh and energy_kwh and power_w from the charging core, and the running cost the charger's display shows. A read keeps the session's bench lease from idling out.

post.summary: Continue after hosted checkout
post.description: Reads the payment of an awaiting_payment session and starts charging once it is authorized. Idempotent.

post.summary: Stop charging
post.description: Sends the station stop command (OCPP RemoteStopTransaction) for the session's transaction. The EV stays plugged in; settle once status is stopped. Idempotent.

post.summary: Finalize and capture the real bill
post.description: After the transaction completed: finalizes the bench bill from the core's kWh, captures it and releases the charger (the EV unplugs). Idempotent.

post.summary: Cancel before charging
post.description: Unplugs the EV, releases the charger and the authorization. A session that charged is stopped and settled instead (the sweep settles it once the transaction completed). After a dispatched start the authorization is released once its charging token expired (status canceling); if that start produced a transaction after all, it is settled.

post.summary: Lease a virtual charger
post.description: Leases a free OCPP bench charger (one per workspace and one per user; 409 pool_exhausted with Retry-After when every charger is leased) and connects it where target says (GET /v1/sessions/targets; global when omitted): the project's per-project URL or a ready custom OCPP domain (as the bench's station p<project>-ivora-bench, stations:write on target.tenant_id), or a custom URL with its identity and optional password (signed-in users only, kept in memory and masked, every custom-URL guardrail and limit). max_power_kw (3.7-22) is the simulated EV's maximum draw. The EV is not plugged in: press plug. Status connecting, then online. Retry with the same Idempotency-Key. A global target whose tenant_id is a dedicated bench tenant of this environment (staff only: the CAD bench) leases that tenant's own charger instead of one from the shared pool. 409 bench_unavailable where /v1/capabilities reports ocpp_bench false. No bill, no payment authorization and no payment provider: billing is whatever the target system does with the OCPP messages. Runs on an EVerest charger of the OCPP bench through real OCPP: never a physical charger at a site, never live Stripe.

get.summary: List the workspace's virtual chargers
get.description: Newest first, without their screens (read one for its display).

get.summary: Read a virtual charger's screen
get.description: What the charger's display shows: the connection (connecting, online, refused with reason), each connector's OCPP status, the transaction the target started, kW, kWh (from the charger's Wh), elapsed time, the running cost and price the target pushed, and its QR / checkout URL, with the latest display messages (redacted). Poll every 2-5 seconds; a read keeps the lease from idling out (15 minutes).

post.summary: Plug the EV in
post.description: The simulated EV plugs in (connector Preparing) and draws up to the lease's power once the target system starts a transaction (RemoteStartTransaction) or a card is accepted. Errors: 409 control_refused, 409 virtual_charger_ended, 503 bench_charger_unavailable. See [Errors and statuses](https://ivoracharge.co/developers/guides/reference/errors).

post.summary: Unplug the EV
post.description: The EV leaves; a running transaction ends (StopTransaction reason EVDisconnected) and faults clear. Errors: 409 control_refused, 409 virtual_charger_ended, 503 bench_charger_unavailable. See [Errors and statuses](https://ivoracharge.co/developers/guides/reference/errors).

post.summary: Press the charger's stop button
post.description: Ends the running transaction locally (StopTransaction reason Local); the EV stays plugged in. Errors: 409 control_refused, 409 virtual_charger_ended, 503 bench_charger_unavailable. See [Errors and statuses](https://ivoracharge.co/developers/guides/reference/errors).

post.summary: Tap an RFID card
post.description: As a real charger's reader: the charger sends Authorize with id_tag and starts a transaction (StartTransaction) when the target accepts it and the EV is plugged in, in either order within the charger's ConnectionTimeOut (display.connection_timeout_s). The transaction's own card again stops it (StopTransaction reason Local); another card stops it only when the target answers the same parentIdTag, else nothing stops (outcome not_owner). The result (Accepted, Blocked, Expired, Invalid, ConcurrentTx, expiryDate, parentIdTag) and its outcome appear in display.authorization. The idTag is never stored or logged; this leaser's own signed-in reads show it in full; every other read (other members, API keys, staff) masked. Errors: 409 control_refused, 409 virtual_charger_ended, 503 bench_charger_unavailable. See [Errors and statuses](https://ivoracharge.co/developers/guides/reference/errors).

post.summary: Inject a fault
post.description: A fault from the plugged-in EV: rcd (GroundFailure), diode or error-e; unplug clears it. Errors: 409 control_refused, 409 virtual_charger_ended, 503 bench_charger_unavailable. See [Errors and statuses](https://ivoracharge.co/developers/guides/reference/errors).

post.summary: Reboot the charger
post.description: A power cycle: the charger restarts and boots again at the same target (BootNotification). Returns once it stopped; read the screen for its reconnection. Errors: 409 control_refused, 409 virtual_charger_ended, 503 bench_charger_unavailable. See [Errors and statuses](https://ivoracharge.co/developers/guides/reference/errors).

post.summary: Release the virtual charger
post.description: Restores the bench charger: the EV unplugs (ending a running transaction at the target), the route is removed and, after a project or custom target, the charger is factory reset; status releasing until that is done, then ended. Idle (15 minutes without a request) and maximum-age expiry do the same. Idempotent.

patch.summary: Rename, configure, pause, complete or archive a migration
patch.description: Any of name, settings (only the fields sent change) and status, in one change. The lifecycle: active and paused switch both ways; paused stops imports and batches (its running batches pause with it, migration.batch.paused reason migration_paused; resume them once it is active again) while rollbacks still go through the charger proxy and its runner. completed (from active or paused) makes the migration a read-only record of the move: imports, batches, chargers, invites and new runner credentials are refused; reopen it with status active and a reason. archived (from paused or completed; an active migration is paused or completed first) closes it for good and releases its chargers, which another migration can then add; its records stay readable by its participants. Rollbacks are never refused because of the status: Ivora can always roll back, through the migration's runner. Completing or archiving waits until no batch is approved, running or paused and no route request (a rollback on its way to the charger proxy) is open. Sending the current status or values changes nothing. Each change is audited (migration.settings.changed, migration.paused, migration.resumed, migration.completed, migration.reopened, migration.archived) in the same transaction; nothing changes when its entry cannot be stored. Needs the client role (its owners and admins; a key needs stations:admin) or Ivora support, which acts on the client's behalf and is audited as support. Errors: 404 migration_not_found, 409 migration_batches_open, 409 migration_closed, 409 migration_routes_open, 409 migration_status_invalid, 503 migration_audit_unavailable. See [Errors and statuses](https://ivoracharge.co/developers/guides/reference/errors).

The invite lapses after 14 days. Invited teams see this migration and nothing else of the project. Needs the client role (its owners and admins; a key needs stations:admin) or Ivora support, which acts on the client's behalf and is audited as support. A retry with the same Idempotency-Key returns the same invite; nothing is invited unless its audit entry is stored. post.summary: Generate or rotate a migration charger's Ivora connection password
post.description: Ivora generates a random 40-character password, sets it on the station (stored for its next connection; nothing is sent to the charger) and keeps a sealed copy that only this migration's charger proxy fetches over its runner channel. The password is never returned here, shown in any view, logged or audited: the reply is its status (password_status, as on the board). The first call sets it, a later one rotates it; after a rotation the proxy fetches the new one (the runner heartbeat's charger_passwords_revision moves) before the charger next connects to Ivora. Allowed only while the charger is still on the previous platform: refused while it is connected to Ivora (a shadow connection included), or the proxy routes it to Ivora, so a rotation never changes a live Ivora connection's password. A network import into the migration does this for each station it creates. Setting the station's password by hand afterwards (the station credentials route) drops the sealed copy (state replaced). At most 30 a minute per caller and migration. Refused on a completed or archived migration. Ivora deletes its sealed copy some days (7 unless Ivora set another number) after the charger leaves the migration, or the migration is completed or archived (state purged). Only where Ivora generates charger passwords for the project (an Ivora setting, off by default): elsewhere this route answers as one that does not exist. Needs the client role (its owners and admins; a key needs stations:admin) or Ivora support, which acts on the client's behalf and is audited as support. Audited in the same transaction. Errors: 404 migration_charger_not_in_migration, 404 migration_not_found, 404 not_found, 409 migration_charger_on_ivora, 409 migration_closed, 409 request_in_progress, 429 rate_limited, 502 migration_charger_password_unconfirmed, 503 migration_audit_unavailable. See [Errors and statuses](https://ivoracharge.co/developers/guides/reference/errors).

post.description: A rollback job: every charger in scope (station_ids, location_ids, batch_id or all: true) that is routed to or connected on Ivora, or whose move is still out, gets a rollback that the charger proxy applies within seconds, immediate and also while charging (a session running on Ivora is then reconciled by hand). Nothing is sent to a charger. Chargers that cannot be rolled back now are listed as skipped (already_rolled_back, rollback_pending, not_proxied). Above 50 chargers socket closes are paced at the migration's drain_per_second; 50 or fewer go at once. Each rollback is the one GET /v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/migration/rollbacks/{rollback_id} reads. Needs the client or support role (a key needs stations:admin), which roll back any charger, or the partner role, which rolls back the chargers its own team moved while inside the migration's rollback window (403 migration_rollback_not_permitted otherwise; with location_ids or all: true the others are left out). A narrowed team's scope is its sites. A rollback pauses every running batch of the migration; with batch_id (refused unless every charger of the batch is at the caller's sites; with a partner, its own moves only) the batch stops for good (rolled_back) once the job takes back every charger it moved or is moving, and otherwise stays paused. Whatever the migration's status: Ivora can always roll back, so a paused, completed or archived migration's runner still applies it (after completion the previous platform may have dropped the charger; check it there first). A retry with the same Idempotency-Key returns the job as it is now. Its audit entries never block it. Errors: 403 forbidden, 403 migration_rollback_not_permitted, 404 migration_batch_not_found, 404 migration_charger_not_in_migration, 404 migration_not_found, 409 migration_nothing_to_roll_back. See [Errors and statuses](https://ivoracharge.co/developers/guides/reference/errors).

get.summary: Read a migration job and its per-charger progress
get.description: A rollback job, or a batch's moves. Each charger: its route request (revision, not_before), the proxy's outcome, the rollback's status and the reconnect status. Any participant; a narrowed team sees the chargers at its sites. Errors: 404 migration_job_not_found, 404 migration_not_found. See [Errors and statuses](https://ivoracharge.co/developers/guides/reference/errors).

get.summary: List a migration's batches
get.description: Oldest first, with each batch's status, pacing, counts per step, approval and timings (chargers null: read one batch for them). Filter: status (repeat for more). Any participant; a narrowed team sees the batches with a charger at its sites, counted there. Errors: 404 migration_not_found. See [Errors and statuses](https://ivoracharge.co/developers/guides/reference/errors).

post.summary: Plan a batch of chargers to move
post.description: A draft batch of the migration's chargers (station_ids, or every charger at location_ids; 500 at most), each in one open batch at a time. Pacing: wave_size chargers move at a time; the next wave starts interval_seconds after the last one settled; the first wave is a canary of canary chargers, after which the batch pauses itself; a share of failures above max_failure_ratio pauses it; a charger refused as busy (charging) is retried in a later wave until idle_timeout_minutes, then blocked, never forced; a move the proxy has not answered after move_timeout_minutes expires and counts as failed. Needs migration:plan (client, support, partner; a key needs stations:write); a narrowed team plans the chargers at its sites only. A retry with the same Idempotency-Key returns the same batch; nothing is created unless its audit entry is stored. Needs an active migration (409 migration_closed when it is paused, completed or archived). Errors: 404 migration_charger_not_in_migration, 404 migration_not_found, 409 migration_charger_in_batch, 409 migration_closed, 503 migration_audit_unavailable. See [Errors and statuses](https://ivoracharge.co/developers/guides/reference/errors).

get.summary: Read a batch and each charger's step
get.description: The batch with each charger's step (pending, moving, moved, blocked, failed, superseded, skipped), its move request and how long the move took, and the rollback jobs of its chargers with their timings. Any participant; a narrowed team sees the chargers at its sites. Errors: 404 migration_batch_not_found, 404 migration_not_found. See [Errors and statuses](https://ivoracharge.co/developers/guides/reference/errors).

patch.summary: Edit a batch that has not started
patch.description: name, station_ids (replaces the chargers) or pacing values. A draft, submitted or approved batch only; the batch returns to draft, so a submission and an approval are withdrawn and the client approves it again. Needs migration:plan. Needs an active migration (409 migration_closed when it is paused, completed or archived). Errors: 404 migration_batch_not_found, 404 migration_charger_not_in_migration, 404 migration_not_found, 409 migration_batch_state, 409 migration_charger_in_batch, 409 migration_closed, 503 migration_audit_unavailable. See [Errors and statuses](https://ivoracharge.co/developers/guides/reference/errors).

post.summary: Submit a batch for the client's approval
post.description: A draft becomes submitted. Needs migration:plan. Repeating it on a batch already there changes nothing. Audited in the same transaction. Errors: 404 migration_batch_not_found, 404 migration_not_found, 409 migration_batch_state, 409 migration_closed, 503 migration_audit_unavailable. See [Errors and statuses](https://ivoracharge.co/developers/guides/reference/errors).

post.summary: Approve a batch (the client)
post.description: A submitted batch becomes approved, bound to its charger set and pacing: any later edit withdraws the approval. Only the client approves (its owners and admins; a key needs stations:admin), and a batch a partner submitted is approved by someone else than its submitter. Repeating it on a batch already there changes nothing. Audited in the same transaction. Errors: 403 migration_four_eyes, 404 migration_batch_not_found, 404 migration_not_found, 409 migration_batch_state, 409 migration_closed, 503 migration_audit_unavailable. See [Errors and statuses](https://ivoracharge.co/developers/guides/reference/errors).

post.summary: Start an approved batch
post.description: The first wave's move requests (kind move, require_idle) go to the charger proxy's runner at once; the proxy moves a charger only when it is idle and its own checks pass. Refused unless the batch is approved and a runner was seen in the last 60 seconds. Its moves are asked in the starter's name. Needs migration:execute (client, support, partner; a key needs stations:admin). Repeating it on a batch already there changes nothing. Audited in the same transaction. Errors: 404 migration_batch_not_found, 404 migration_not_found, 409 migration_batch_state, 409 migration_closed, 409 migration_runner_unhealthy, 503 migration_audit_unavailable. See [Errors and statuses](https://ivoracharge.co/developers/guides/reference/errors).

post.summary: Pause a running batch
post.description: No new wave starts. Moves no runner has received yet are withdrawn (their chargers wait again and are re-sent on resume); a move a runner received finishes and is recorded. Needs migration:execute. Allowed whatever the migration's status. Repeating it on a batch already there changes nothing. Audited in the same transaction. Errors: 404 migration_batch_not_found, 404 migration_not_found, 409 migration_batch_state, 503 migration_audit_unavailable. See [Errors and statuses](https://ivoracharge.co/developers/guides/reference/errors).

post.summary: Resume a paused batch
post.description: After a manual pause, the canary wave, too many failures, a rollback or a missing runner. Refused unless a runner was seen in the last 60 seconds. Its next moves are asked in the resumer's name. Needs migration:execute. Repeating it on a batch already there changes nothing. Audited in the same transaction. Errors: 404 migration_batch_not_found, 404 migration_not_found, 409 migration_batch_state, 409 migration_closed, 409 migration_runner_unhealthy, 503 migration_audit_unavailable. See [Errors and statuses](https://ivoracharge.co/developers/guides/reference/errors).

post.summary: Cancel a batch
post.description: Stops it for good: the chargers waiting and the moves no runner has received yet are skipped, a move a runner received finishes, and chargers already moved stay on Ivora (cancelling never rolls back; roll the batch back for that). Needs migration:plan for a draft or submitted batch, migration:execute otherwise. Allowed whatever the migration's status. Repeating it on a batch already there changes nothing. Audited in the same transaction. Errors: 404 migration_batch_not_found, 404 migration_not_found, 409 migration_batch_state, 503 migration_audit_unavailable. See [Errors and statuses](https://ivoracharge.co/developers/guides/reference/errors).

get.summary: Read a migration's audit log
get.description: Every entry of this migration and nothing else: who created it, added chargers, asked for rollbacks, the proxy's results, invited teams and runner credentials, with the actor's own team (actor_team_id). Any participant, signed in; API keys cannot read it. A team narrowed to some sites reads its own team's entries only. Filters: action (exact or a family such as migration.runner), actor, since, until. Newest first. Errors: 404 migration_not_found. See [Errors and statuses](https://ivoracharge.co/developers/guides/reference/errors).

post.summary: Create a runner credential for the migration's charger proxy
post.description: The credential the proxy's sync agent uses on this migration's runner routes (GET .../routes, POST .../routes/reports, POST .../runners/heartbeat), with the single scope migration:routes. Shown once, never stored: keep it on the proxy host only. Every other route refuses it. Needs the client or support role (a key needs stations:admin). Audited in the same transaction (503 when it cannot be). Errors: 404 migration_not_found, 409 migration_closed, 503 migration_audit_unavailable. See [Errors and statuses](https://ivoracharge.co/developers/guides/reference/errors).

delete.description: Takes effect at once. A repeat changes nothing. Needs the client or support role. Errors: 404 migration_not_found, 404 migration_runner_not_found, 503 migration_audit_unavailable. See [Errors and statuses](https://ivoracharge.co/developers/guides/reference/errors).

post.summary: Create a team migration key
post.description: An API key of your participant team on this migration, for the Ivora CLI or a partner's integration, with the environment's usual key prefix. scopes are migration permissions (migration:read, migration:rollback, ...), each one your own role here holds. Needs an owner or admin of the client's or an invited team; Ivora support uses staff keys. Shown once. At most 20 active keys per team and migration. Nothing is created unless its audit entry is stored. Signed-in users only: an API key cannot manage keys. The key acts on this migration's routes and GET /v1/access only; every project route (/v1/tenants/...) refuses it. On every request it holds the scopes its creator's current role in the migration still allows, so a downgrade takes effect at once and the key stops when they leave the team or the team leaves the migration (which also revokes its keys). Errors: 403 migration_key_not_permitted, 404 migration_not_found, 409 migration_key_limit, 503 migration_audit_unavailable. See [Errors and statuses](https://ivoracharge.co/developers/guides/reference/errors).

get.summary: List a migration's team keys
get.description: Newest first, never the secrets. The client and Ivora support see every team's keys; a team's owners and admins see their own team's. Signed-in users only: an API key cannot manage keys. The key acts on this migration's routes and GET /v1/access only; every project route (/v1/tenants/...) refuses it. On every request it holds the scopes its creator's current role in the migration still allows, so a downgrade takes effect at once and the key stops when they leave the team or the team leaves the migration (which also revokes its keys). Errors: 403 migration_key_not_permitted, 404 migration_not_found. See [Errors and statuses](https://ivoracharge.co/developers/guides/reference/errors).

delete.description: Takes effect at once. A team's owners and admins revoke its keys; the client and Ivora support revoke any. A repeat changes nothing. Signed-in users only: an API key cannot manage keys. The key acts on this migration's routes and GET /v1/access only; every project route (/v1/tenants/...) refuses it. On every request it holds the scopes its creator's current role in the migration still allows, so a downgrade takes effect at once and the key stops when they leave the team or the team leaves the migration (which also revokes its keys). Errors: 403 migration_key_not_permitted, 404 migration_key_not_found, 404 migration_not_found, 503 migration_audit_unavailable. See [Errors and statuses](https://ivoracharge.co/developers/guides/reference/errors).

get.summary: Pull the desired routes (runner, long poll)
get.description: The open route requests newer than after_revision, oldest first, as soon as there is one, waiting at most wait seconds (25 at most). A rollback is applied at once (require_idle false). With after_revision 0 the reply also carries every charger's desired route. limit caps the requests handed out (default and most 500); open rollbacks come first within it. revision, the next after_revision, covers only requests handed out (every open request at or below it is in this reply or an earlier one), so a rollback above it can be handed out again: apply requests once by id. Report each outcome with POST .../routes/reports. Runner credential only (POST /v1/migrations/{migration_id}/runners, scope migration:routes); any other credential is refused, whatever the migration's status (Ivora can always roll back: on a completed or archived migration the runner idles until one comes).

post.summary: Report route outcomes and current routes (runner)
post.description: Batched: each charger's current route and connections, with the outcome of a request (request_id) or none (its state, or a change made on the proxy itself). A rollback's applied outcome with no connection to Ivora emits migration.charger_rolled_back and records the route for QR scans; with a connection to Ivora still open the request is handed out again. A move to Ivora the API did not ask for is audited in the same transaction (503 when it cannot be; the rest of the report is kept). Runner credential only (POST /v1/migrations/{migration_id}/runners, scope migration:routes); any other credential is refused, whatever the migration's status (Ivora can always roll back: on a completed or archived migration the runner idles until one comes). Errors: 503 migration_audit_unavailable. See [Errors and statuses](https://ivoracharge.co/developers/guides/reference/errors).

post.summary: Runner heartbeat
post.description: Every 15 seconds: proxy nodes, upstreams, routed and connected counts. The workspace shows the runner healthy while one arrived within 60 seconds. Not audited. Runner credential only (POST /v1/migrations/{migration_id}/runners, scope migration:routes); any other credential is refused, whatever the migration's status (Ivora can always roll back: on a completed or archived migration the runner idles until one comes).

post.summary: Fetch the migration's charger passwords (runner)
post.description: The Ivora connection passwords the charger proxy presents for its migration's chargers, so no one copies them to the proxy host by hand. Either charger_keys (up to 100 routing keys, for example after Ivora refused a connection), or every charger whose password changed after after_revision, oldest change first (start with 0; pass the reply's revision next time, at once while more is true). A charger with nothing to hand out is listed in unavailable with its state. One charger_key that is not a charger this migration holds refuses the whole request and hands out nothing. Each password handed out writes an audit entry (migration.charger_password.fetched, by runner and charger) in the same transaction, and the board shows it fetched. Every fetch, whatever it hands out (nothing, only unavailable chargers, or a refusal), also writes one migration.charger_password.fetch entry with counts only (no password, no charger key), in the same transaction. When an entry cannot be stored, nothing is handed out and nothing is marked fetched (migration_audit_unavailable). At most 12 fetches a minute per runner credential. The reply is never cached (Cache-Control: no-store); this is the only route that returns a charger password. Ivora deletes its sealed copy some days (7 unless Ivora set another number) after a charger leaves the migration, or the migration is completed or archived: from then on the charger is listed in unavailable (state purged) and no password of it is handed out. Only where Ivora generates charger passwords for the project (an Ivora setting, off by default): elsewhere this route answers as one that does not exist. Runner credential only (POST /v1/migrations/{migration_id}/runners, scope migration:routes); any other credential is refused, whatever the migration's status (Ivora can always roll back: on a completed or archived migration the runner idles until one comes). Errors: 404 migration_charger_not_in_migration, 404 not_found, 429 rate_limited, 503 migration_audit_unavailable. See [Errors and statuses](https://ivoracharge.co/developers/guides/reference/errors).

get.summary: List migration invites to you
get.description: Open invites to your confirmed email, and to the teams you own or administer, oldest first. Accept one for a team you own or administer, or for a new team. Signed-in users only, with or without a team.

post.summary: Join a migration with your team
post.description: An invite to a team is accepted for that team by one of its owners or admins. An invite to your email is accepted for a team you own or administer (team_id) or a new team you name (team_name), with you as its owner; a team with no project has no usage fee and needs no payment method. The team then sees this migration, and nothing else of the client's project. Errors: 403 migration_team_role_required, 404 migration_invite_not_found, 409 migration_invite_closed, 409 migration_participant_exists, 410 migration_invite_expired, 503 migration_audit_unavailable. See [Errors and statuses](https://ivoracharge.co/developers/guides/reference/errors).

post.summary: Decline a migration invite
post.description: An invite to a team is declined by one of its owners or admins, an invite to your email by you, and recorded in the migration's audit log. Errors: 404 migration_invite_not_found, 409 migration_invite_closed, 410 migration_invite_expired, 503 migration_audit_unavailable. See [Errors and statuses](https://ivoracharge.co/developers/guides/reference/errors).

put.summary: Record the previous platform's baseline of chargers
put.description: What the previous platform has for each charger, from its export: configuration keys and values, the tariff (currency and prices in minor units) and the sessions it recorded in a window (count and energy in Wh). Parity reports compare it with Ivora's records. A section given replaces that section of the charger's baseline; the others stay. Secret configuration keys (passwords, keys, tokens) and the keys that decide where the charger connects (CentralSystemURL and similar) are dropped and never stored. Prices are minor units, decimals for a sub-cent price. 64 KiB per call (about 25 chargers with a full OCPP 1.6 configuration; tariff-only baselines up to 500); a configuration has at most 300 keys, each value at most 500 characters. Needs migration:import (client, support, partner; a key needs stations:write). A participant narrowed to some sites covers and reads the chargers at its sites only. Audited (migration.parity.baseline_recorded) in the same transaction; nothing is recorded unless its entry is stored. Errors: 404 migration_charger_not_in_migration, 404 migration_not_found, 409 migration_closed, 413 request_too_large, 503 migration_audit_unavailable. See [Errors and statuses](https://ivoracharge.co/developers/guides/reference/errors).

post.summary: Run a parity report: compare chargers with the previous platform
post.description: For each charger in scope (station_ids, location_ids or all: true; 500 at most), compares its baseline with Ivora's records: configuration (the keys of the baseline against the configuration Ivora recorded; keys that decide where the charger connects and secrets are skipped; on OCPP 2.x the Actual attribute only, and a label with different values on several EVSEs is skipped as ambiguous), tariff (the price of each connector, as Ivora would bill it; a complex tariff, with elements, rules or a time zone, is not checked: complex_tariff) and sessions (count and energy of the sessions that started in the baseline's window, within tolerances; without baseline sessions, an OCPP 1.6 charger in shadow mode is compared with the sessions the charger proxy recorded from the control link, in since..until). A charger passes when no section fails and every section in require passed, else it failed or is incomplete. A charger on the previous platform whose latest report passed is parity_checked on the board until it moves. Read-only for chargers: nothing is sent to a charger and nothing in Ivora's records of it changes. Needs migration:plan (client, support, partner; a key needs stations:write). A participant narrowed to some sites covers and reads the chargers at its sites only. A retry with the same Idempotency-Key returns the same report. Audited (migration.parity.checked) in the same transaction; nothing is stored unless its entry is. Errors: 404 migration_charger_not_in_migration, 404 migration_not_found, 409 migration_closed, 503 migration_audit_unavailable. See [Errors and statuses](https://ivoracharge.co/developers/guides/reference/errors).

get.summary: List a migration's parity reports
get.description: Newest first, with each report's scope, window, tolerances and counts (chargers null: read one report for them). Any participant. A participant narrowed to some sites covers and reads the chargers at its sites only. Its list leaves out the reports with none of its chargers, and its counts and scope cover them. An unknown cursor is refused (422 invalid_request). Errors: 404 migration_not_found. See [Errors and statuses](https://ivoracharge.co/developers/guides/reference/errors).

role.title: Role
role.description: The person's team role when they accepted (always owner).

state.title: State
state.description: waiting: plugged in before the first charging, priced as neither TIME nor PARKING_TIME.

method.title: Method
method.description: ocpp201_charging_state: the charger's OCPP 2.x chargingState. ocpp16_status: OCPP 1.6 connector statuses (Charging; SuspendedEV, SuspendedEVSE and Finishing are idle). ocpp16_status_and_power: those statuses, plus idle wherever the meter shows almost no power for a while. meter_power: the meter alone. none: not enough data; the whole transaction is charging time, as before idle detection (unless it drew less than 1 Wh: see reason no_energy).

detected.title: Detected
detected.description: False: method none, and reason says why. A session with less than 1 Wh is all waiting (reason no_energy), and detected is true then, also with method none.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why nothing was detected (for example no_state_or_meter_data); no_energy: a session with less than 1 Wh is all waiting, billing neither TIME nor PARKING_TIME nor energy; else null.

waiting_seconds.title: Waiting Seconds
