scopes.description: Project scopes. Never billing:refund or stations:admin, and never staff or API-key routes.

checkout_service.title: Checkout Service
checkout_service.description: Whether Ivora trusts the app's backend to name the driver's IP address (X-Ivora-Driver-Address) on payment creation, so the 30-a-minute per-address limit counts per driver: honoured only on a client_credentials token of an install holding billing:write, never on a session or exchanged token. Only Ivora administrators set it (403 otherwise), on an app that requests billing:write.

visibility.title: Visibility
visibility.description: private: only the owning team's projects can install it. first_party: Ivora's own app, installable by every project and shown as made by Ivora; only Ivora administrators set it (403 otherwise). Back to private is refused (409 app_installed_outside_team) while the app is installed in a project outside its team.

scopes.title: Scopes
scopes.description: The scopes the app requests; an install holds the part its installer consented to.

webhook_url.title: Webhook Url
webhook_url.description: Null for a first_party app read from another team's project.

revision.title: Revision
revision.description: Counts the changes to the app's scopes, origins and extensions. A consent is valid only for the revision it was given on.

visibility.title: Visibility
visibility.description: private: only the owning team's projects can install it. first_party: Ivora's own app, installable by every project and shown as made by Ivora; only Ivora administrators set it (403 otherwise).

publisher.title: Publisher
publisher.description: Ivora for a first_party app, which the dashboard shows as made by Ivora; null: the team that registered it.

checkout_service.title: Checkout Service
checkout_service.description: Whether Ivora trusts the app's backend to name the driver's IP address (X-Ivora-Driver-Address) on payment creation, so the 30-a-minute per-address limit counts per driver: honoured only on a client_credentials token of an install holding billing:write, never on a session or exchanged token. Only Ivora administrators set it (403 otherwise), on an app that requests billing:write.

secret_prefix.title: Secret Prefix
secret_prefix.description: The client secret's first characters, to recognise it; the secret is shown only when it is created or rotated. Null for a first_party app read from another team's project.

created_by.title: Created By
created_by.description: Null for a first_party app read from another team's project.

installs.title: Installs
installs.description: Active installs, in the team's projects.

webhook_secret.title: Webhook Secret
webhook_secret.description: Shown once. The earlier signing key stops signing at once.

chargers.title: Chargers
chargers.description: Chargers in the batch when it was approved.

digest.title: Digest
digest.description: SHA-256 of the approved charger set and pacing; any edit revokes the approval.

tenant_id.title: Tenant Id
tenant_id.description: The project (tenant) the app may act on. One project per grant.

team_id.title: Team Id
team_id.description: Optional: the project's team, checked when given.

scopes.title: Scopes
scopes.description: The scopes granted, within the project scopes you hold. Read-only scopes are the default; write scopes and stations:admin are opt-in.

id.title: Id
id.description: The entry's ID.

actor.title: Actor
actor.description: Who did it: user:{id} for a person, access-sync for the automatic import of a sign-in grant, or a staff or system actor.

action.title: Action
action.description: What happened, such as team.member.added, team.invite.created, project.created, project.renamed, project.api_key.created.

team_id.title: Team Id
team_id.description: The team, for team entries and every entry of a team's project; null for entries outside any team.

tenant_id.title: Tenant Id
tenant_id.description: The project's tenant ID; null for team-level entries.

target.title: Target
target.description: What it was done to: a user, invite or key ID, or a project ID.

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: Identifiers, roles and labels; never a secret, an email or card data.

migration_id.title: Migration Id
migration_id.description: The migration workspace the entry belongs to (mig_...), else null.

actor_team_id.title: Actor Team Id
actor_team_id.description: The actor's own team in a migration entry (team_id is the project's), else null.

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next, older page; null on the last page.

connector_number.title: Connector Number
connector_number.description: The connector's position on its EVSE

source.title: Source
source.description: The CSV line an evse_number or connector_type was written into

type.title: Type
type.description: us_bank_account: ACH Direct Debit (US). acss_debit: Canadian pre-authorized debit, in US dollars (a USD account at a Canadian bank).

status.title: Status
status.description: verified: the mandate is active and an enterprise invoice is debited on its due date. pending_verification: confirm the microdeposits Stripe sent before it can be debited.

url.title: Url
url.description: Stripe-hosted page that connects and verifies the team's bank account (instantly through the bank, or by microdeposits) and accepts the debit mandate; nothing is charged. Open it now.

type.title: Type
type.description: aba (ACH credit and domestic wire) or swift (international wire).

financial_addresses.title: Financial Addresses
financial_addresses.description: The team's own virtual account at Stripe: an ACH credit or wire to it pays the team's open invoices.

configuration.title: Configuration
configuration.description: The charger's configuration on the previous platform: key to value (at most 300 keys, values at most 500 characters), keys named as Ivora's configuration read names them (OCPP 1.6 keys such as MeterValueSampleInterval; OCPP 2.x component/variable labels). Secret keys (passwords, keys, tokens) and the keys that decide where the charger connects (CentralSystemURL and similar) are dropped, never stored.

tariff.description: The price the previous platform charges on it.

sessions.description: The sessions the previous platform recorded on it in a window.

chargers.title: Chargers
chargers.description: Each charger's baseline; a section given replaces that section of its earlier baseline, the sections left out stay. The body is at most 64 KiB: about 25 chargers with a full OCPP 1.6 configuration, up to 500 with a tariff only.

dropped_keys.title: Dropped Keys
dropped_keys.description: Configuration keys left out, never stored: secrets, and the keys that decide where the charger connects (never compared; a URL can carry credentials).

since.title: Since
since.description: The window's start (ISO 8601 with offset), inclusive: sessions that started at or after it.

until.title: Until
until.description: The window's end (ISO 8601 with offset), exclusive. At most 31 days after since.

count.title: Count
count.description: Sessions the previous platform recorded on the charger that started in the window.

rate_minor_per_kwh.title: Rate Minor Per Kwh
rate_minor_per_kwh.description: Energy price, minor units per kWh; null or 0: none. Decimal minor units for a sub-cent price (35.5: USD 0.355), at most 4 decimals.

rate_minor_per_minute.title: Rate Minor Per Minute
rate_minor_per_minute.description: Time price, minor units per minute; null or 0: none. Decimal minor units for a sub-cent price (35.5: USD 0.355), at most 4 decimals.

session_fee_minor.title: Session Fee Minor
session_fee_minor.description: Flat fee per session, minor units; null or 0: none. Decimal minor units for a sub-cent price (35.5: USD 0.355), at most 4 decimals.

id.title: Id
id.description: bat_...

status.title: Status
status.description: draft, submitted (waiting for the client's approval), approved, running, paused, completed, cancelled (moved chargers stay on Ivora) or rolled_back (a rollback of the batch was asked).

counts.title: Counts
counts.description: Chargers per step, and total (of the caller's sites when narrowed).

wave_open.title: Wave Open
wave_open.description: A wave's moves are out and not all answered.

next_wave_at.title: Next Wave At
next_wave_at.description: When the next wave may start (running, between waves).

paused_reason.title: Paused Reason
paused_reason.description: Why a paused batch paused: manual, canary (after its first wave), failure_ratio, rollback_requested (a rollback anywhere in the migration), runner_unhealthy or migration_paused (the migration was paused).

approval.description: The client's approval; null until approved, and again after an edit.

started_by.title: Started By
started_by.description: Who started it, or resumed it last: its moves are asked in their name.

duration_s.title: Duration S
duration_s.description: Seconds from its start to its end (or now while it runs).

rollbacks.title: Rollbacks
rollbacks.description: Rollback jobs of its chargers, with their timings.

chargers.title: Chargers
chargers.description: Each charger's step; null in a list.

pacing.description: The pacing values to change; the others stay.

step.title: Step
step.description: pending: waiting for its wave (detail busy: refused while charging, retried at retry_at). moving: its move request is out. moved: on Ivora. blocked: not moved (detail not_idle, not_proxied, shadow, rollback_pending). failed: the proxy failed or refused it, or did not answer in time (detail refused_parity, failed, expired). superseded: a rollback took over. skipped: the batch was cancelled or rolled back first, or the charger left the migration (detail).

wave.title: Wave
wave.description: The wave of its latest move request.

attempts.title: Attempts
attempts.description: Move requests sent for it (a busy charger is retried).

retry_at.title: Retry At
retry_at.description: A busy charger's next attempt at the earliest.

move_s.title: Move S
move_s.description: Seconds from its move request to the proxy's report that it moved.

name.title: Name
name.description: A label, such as "Depot, night 1".

location_ids.title: Location Ids
location_ids.description: Or every migration charger at these sites (500 at most).

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page; null on the last one.

chargers.title: Chargers
chargers.description: Chargers it rolls back (skipped ones left out).

applied.title: Applied
applied.description: Chargers switched back by the proxy.

last_applied_at.title: Last Applied At
last_applied_at.description: When the proxy switched the last of them back.

switch_s.title: Switch S
switch_s.description: Seconds from the request to the last switch back.

tariff_id.title: Tariff Id
tariff_id.description: Tenant-owned tariff, snapshotted before charging. Optional: omitted, it is the tariff that applies to the connector: its own, else its location's default, else the project's default (409 connector_tariff_missing when none applies). A tariff other than that one is accepted for now and reported in the response's warnings (tariff_differs_from_connector).

source.title: Source
source.description: Always csms: usage comes from the charging core. Optional.

pricing_group.title: Pricing Group
pricing_group.description: The driver's member or RFID group, for the tariff's group discounts. Frozen with the tariff; ignored by simple tariffs.

merchant_validation.title: Merchant Validation
merchant_validation.description: A merchant validation code, for the tariff's merchant validation rule. Frozen with the tariff.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Your own key/value pairs (strings), such as a site host or a contract ID: at most 50 keys of 1-40 characters of A-Z, a-z, 0-9, underscore, period and hyphen, values of at most 500 characters. Never secrets or personal data. Never published to OCPI roaming partners. Stays writable after creation (PATCH); the station's and location's metadata are snapshot separately when the bill is created (station_metadata, location_metadata).

warnings.title: Warnings
warnings.description: Set only on the response that creates the bill: tariff_differs_from_connector when the requested tariff is not the one that applies to the connector (details: requested_tariff_id, connector_tariff_id, connector_tariff_source).

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: The bill's ISO 4217 currency, its tariff's (USD or CAD); every amount on the bill is in its minor units.

energy_wh.title: Energy Wh
energy_wh.description: Integer Wh of the finalized usage.

total_minor.title: Total Minor
total_minor.description: Final bills: what the driver pays, in minor units, tax included when the bill has tax.

billing_version.title: Billing Version
billing_version.description: energy-v1: a simple tariff, total_minor = round_half_up(kWh × rate_minor). elements-v1: a complex tariff's elements and rules, frozen when the bill was created; rate_minor is its base rate.

cost_breakdown.description: Final bills finalized from 2026-10-15: the itemised lines and adjustments behind total_minor, from the same calculation as tariff quotes.

limit.description: The session limit set when the bill was started, with its stop and, once final, the overrun.

tax.description: Bills at a location with tax lines: the configuration frozen when the bill was created. Absent without tax. usage.estimated_minor and total_minor include it; cost_breakdown.tax itemises it.

return_url.title: Return Url
return_url.description: The return_url its payment was created with, where hosted checkout returns the driver; null otherwise.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Your own key/value pairs (strings), such as a site host or a contract ID: at most 50 keys of 1-40 characters of A-Z, a-z, 0-9, underscore, period and hyphen, values of at most 500 characters. Never secrets or personal data. Never published to OCPI roaming partners.

station_metadata.title: Station Metadata
station_metadata.description: The station's metadata as it was when the bill was created, copied once and never changed afterwards, so historical attribution survives later edits. {} when it had none (or had no station).

location_metadata.title: Location Metadata
location_metadata.description: The location's metadata as it was when the bill was created, copied once and never changed afterwards, so historical attribution survives later edits. {} when it had none (or had no location).

usage.description: Single bill reads only: live matched usage after start, a final snapshot once final.

start_operation.description: Single bill reads only: the journaled start dispatch, if any.

progress.title: Progress
progress.description: Single bill reads only, managed bills: the driver-facing step. awaiting_payment: the hold is not authorized yet (checkout open, card declined or retrying). authorized: authorized, no start dispatched (the application starts it). starting: the start is being dispatched. waiting_for_vehicle: the start reached the charger; no transaction yet (plug in). charging: a matched transaction is active. ended: the transaction ended or the bill is final. start_failed: the start was rejected or its outcome is unknown. canceled: the payment was canceled or its checkout expired before any transaction. Null for externally settled bills and lists.

limit.description: Optional: the platform stops charging when the session reaches it.

price_mode.title: Price Mode
price_mode.description: tax_exclusive (the US norm): tariff prices exclude tax and the lines are added to them. tax_inclusive: tariff prices include every line, and the lines are taken out of the price the driver pays.

lines.title: Lines
lines.description: The lines, in the order they apply, with the registration numbers receipts print.

BillTax.title: BillTax
BillTax.description: The tax configuration a bill froze from its station's location when it was created; its amounts are in cost_breakdown.tax.

rate_cents_per_kwh.title: Rate Cents Per Kwh
rate_cents_per_kwh.description: Ivora's CSMS usage fee for this project in US cents per kWh of charging, a decimal string: the project's override, else the team's rate (default 1.00).

rate_source.title: Rate Source
rate_source.description: team: the team's default rate. project: a per-project override set by Ivora.

invoicing.title: Invoicing
invoicing.description: Invoiced monthly to the team's payment method, one line per project.

team.description: The team (company) billing account that owns the payment method, waiver, grace and invoices.

status.title: Status
status.description: active: the team has a usable card on file. grace: no card yet, until grace_ends_at. enterprise: invoiced with net terms; no card needed, and an overdue invoice never blocks setup by itself. suspended: Ivora suspended the team's new CSMS setup and control (402 billing_suspended). past_due: a monthly invoice payment failed (past_due_since); new CSMS setup and control answer 402 payment_method_required 14 days later until it is paid. payment_method_required: new CSMS setup and control answer 402 payment_method_required. waived: Ivora waived the team's requirement and invoice. exempt: an Ivora internal team or the bench tenant. discounted: no card on file and a 100% discount; invoiced at $0 and no card is needed.

csms_setup_allowed.title: Csms Setup Allowed
csms_setup_allowed.description: Whether new CSMS setup and control (creating stations, locations and CSMS keys, commands, creating bills and external sessions) are allowed. Reads, OCPP traffic, stops and starting an existing bill or session are never blocked.

waived.title: Waived
waived.description: Ivora waived the team's payment method requirement; the team gets no invoice.

discount_percent.title: Discount Percent
discount_percent.description: The team's discount in percent (0 to 100, default 0), set by Ivora: its monthly invoice shows usage at the normal rate, discounted. 100 needs no payment method but is still invoiced (at $0); a waived team gets no invoice at all.

grace_ends_at.title: Grace Ends At
grace_ends_at.description: End of the team's grace period (teams of tenants that existed before the fee: 30 days after its release).

past_due_since.title: Past Due Since
past_due_since.description: When a payment of the team's monthly usage-fee invoice first failed; cleared once the unpaid invoices are paid.

billing_mode.title: Billing Mode
billing_mode.description: self_serve: the card on file is charged automatically. enterprise (set by Ivora): a monthly invoice with net terms, paid by bank debit, bank transfer or as invoice_terms allow; no card needed.

invoice_terms.description: enterprise only. The team's billing contacts, PO number and bank transfer instructions are on GET /v1/teams/{team_id}/billing.

bank_account.description: The team's bank account for enterprise invoices (ACH or pre-authorized debit).

setup_pending.title: Setup Pending
setup_pending.description: A payment method setup was started for the team and not yet synchronized.

payment_mode.title: Payment Mode
payment_mode.description: Stripe mode of Ivora's platform account here; only production is live.

current_month.description: The project's usage so far this UTC calendar month and its estimated usage fee, by the monthly invoice's rule; null when the CSMS cannot be read right now.

group_discounts.title: Group Discounts
group_discounts.description: Member/RFID group discounts: the largest matching one applies; they never stack.

merchant_validation.description: A discount when the session carries a merchant validation code.

max_session_cost_minor.title: Max Session Cost Minor
max_session_cost_minor.description: Cap on a session's total, integer minor units.

idle_grace_minutes.title: Idle Grace Minutes
idle_grace_minutes.description: Free idle minutes: PARKING_TIME is charged only for idle time beyond the first N minutes of each session, counted from when charging ends. Partners over OCPI still see the plain PARKING_TIME price; the generated tariff text says 'idle fee after N free minutes' and the CDR carries the parking time actually charged. 0 or omitted: no grace.

prepaid_limit.title: Prepaid Limit
prepaid_limit.description: Report, on quotes for sessions with prepaid_balance_minor, how much the balance covers and whether the session reaches it. It never changes the total; your application stops or tops up.

BillingRules.title: BillingRules
BillingRules.description:
Ivora billing rules applied after the elements, in this order, and never published over OCPI: partners see the
elements and tariff_alt_text only.

id.title: Id
id.description: The team billing account (team_...); null until it is first stored (the first card setup or staff change).

rate_cents_per_kwh.title: Rate Cents Per Kwh
rate_cents_per_kwh.description: The team's default usage fee in US cents per kWh, a decimal string (default 1.00).

discount_percent.title: Discount Percent
discount_percent.description: The team's discount in percent (0 to 100, default 0), set by Ivora: its monthly invoice shows usage at the normal rate, discounted. 100 needs no payment method but is still invoiced (at $0); a waived team gets no invoice at all.

tenant_ids.title: Tenant Ids
tenant_ids.description: The team's projects (tenants); one invoice per team per month with a line per project.

logo_url.title: Logo Url
logo_url.description: Null when the tenant set a name but no logo: show the name as text.

terms_url.title: Terms Url
terms_url.description: The operator's terms and conditions page (https), or null: link checkout's terms checkbox to it, else name the operator's terms without a link.

checkout_origin.title: Checkout Origin
checkout_origin.description: Origin of checkout links for this brand: the project's checkout_domain while it is ready, else the default payment host. Checkout links encode <checkout_origin>/checkout/<station>-<evse>.

source.title: Source
source.description: How the brand was chosen: the payment domain the page is served on, the charger's tenant, or Ivora's default.

is_default.title: Is Default
is_default.description: True while the tenant has set no branding: drivers see Ivora's.

sticker_url_template.title: Sticker Url Template
sticker_url_template.description: What new QR stickers and cards encode: the project's qr_domain while it is ready (https://<qr_domain>/{station_name}), else its checkout_origin's checkout page per EVSE.

name.title: Name
name.description: The station's OCPP connection name.

state.title: State
state.description: imported: in the migration, neither the proxy nor a site flip recorded its route yet. proxied: routed to the previous platform through the proxy. shadow: routed to the previous platform, with shadow mode on (Ivora observes a copy of its traffic). parity_checked: routed to the previous platform, its latest parity report passed and it was not on Ivora since. moved: routed to Ivora. rolling_back: a rollback is asked and not finished. rolled_back: routed back to the previous platform after it was on Ivora.

state_since.title: State Since
state_since.description: When the charger entered its state.

route.title: Route
route.description: Where the proxy routes it, from its latest report.

route_desired.title: Route Desired
route_desired.description: The route last asked for through the API; a batch's move shows here only once the proxy reported it applied.

reported_by.title: Reported By
reported_by.description: The proxy that reported it last.

proxy_stale.title: Proxy Stale
proxy_stale.description: The latest report is more than five minutes old.

batch.description: The latest batch the charger is in; null when it never was in one.

parity.description: Its latest parity report: whether it passed, and when; null when it was never checked.

password_status.description: The status of the charger's Ivora-generated connection password, which the charger proxy presents to Ivora; never the password. Only where Ivora generates charger passwords for the project; absent otherwise.

id.description: bat_...

step.title: Step
step.description: The charger's step in that batch.

name.description: The station's OCPP connection name.

state_since.title: State Since
state_since.description: When the charger entered its state.

route.title: Route
route.description: Where the proxy routes it, from its latest report.

route_desired.title: Route Desired
route_desired.description: The route last asked for through the API; a batch's move shows here only once the proxy reported it applied.

reported_by.title: Reported By
reported_by.description: The proxy that reported it last.

proxy_stale.title: Proxy Stale
proxy_stale.description: The latest report is more than five minutes old.

batch.description: The latest batch the charger is in; null when it never was in one.

parity.description: Its latest parity report: whether it passed, and when; null when it was never checked.

password_status.description: The status of the charger's Ivora-generated connection password, which the charger proxy presents to Ivora; never the password. Only where Ivora generates charger passwords for the project; absent otherwise.

history.title: History
history.description: Its state changes, newest first (the last 100).

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Pass as cursor (a charger_key) for the next page; null on the last one.

charger_keys.title: Charger Keys
charger_keys.description: Fetch these chargers (routing keys). Omit to fetch every charger whose password changed after after_revision.

after_revision.title: After Revision
after_revision.description: Without charger_keys: the revision of your last fetch (0: every charger).

revision.title: Revision
revision.description: Pass as after_revision on the next fetch; null when you asked by charger_keys.

more.title: More
more.description: More changed chargers are waiting: fetch again with revision.

state.title: State
state.description: not_set: Ivora generated no password for this charger in this migration. set: generated and set on the station; the charger proxy has not fetched it yet. fetched: the proxy's runner fetched the current one. pending: the charging core did not confirm the last change, so nothing is handed out (generate it again). replaced: the station's password was set by hand since, so the proxy has nothing to fetch (generate it again to hand one out). purged: Ivora deleted its copy at the end of its retention, after the migration was completed or archived; a reopened migration generates it again.

set_at.title: Set At
set_at.description: When Ivora first set a generated password on the station.

rotated_at.title: Rotated At
rotated_at.description: When it was last rotated; null when it never was.

fetched_at.title: Fetched At
fetched_at.description: When the proxy's runner last fetched the current password; null after a rotation until it fetches again.

purged_at.title: Purged At
purged_at.description: When Ivora deleted its copy of the password (state purged).

revision.title: Revision
revision.description: Its place in the migration's order of password changes (the runner's cursor).

id.title: Id
id.description: The bench charger leased for this session.

tenant_id.title: Tenant Id
tenant_id.description: The OCPP bench tenant, which owns the station, bill and payment.

connector_id.title: Connector Id
connector_id.description: Connector resource ID on the bench station.

evse.title: Evse
evse.description: The charger's EVSE the simulated EV plugs into.

state.title: State
state.description: While leased: ocpp_status (the connector's last OCPP StatusNotification) and online.

current.title: Current
current.description: Where the proxy routes the charger now.

flipped_at.title: Flipped At
flipped_at.description: When the proxy routed it so (ISO 8601 with offset). An older report never replaces a newer one.

flipped_at.title: Flipped At
flipped_at.description: The recorded state's time: the report's, or a newer one already recorded.

applied.title: Applied
applied.description: false when a newer state was already recorded and this report changed nothing.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: The session's cap in unit, at most one decimal; 0 pauses the session until the cap changes or is removed

number_phases.title: Number Phases
number_phases.description: AC phases the vehicle may use

id.title: Id
id.description: Profile resource ID (chp_...)

ocpp_profile_id.title: Ocpp Profile Id
ocpp_profile_id.description: The chargingProfileId the charger knows the profile by

connector_id.title: Connector Id
connector_id.description: Connector resource ID, null for the whole station

ocpp_target.title: Ocpp Target
ocpp_target.description: OCPP 1.6 connectorId or OCPP 2.x evseId the profile was sent to; 0 is the whole station

utc_offset.title: Utc Offset
utc_offset.description: windows: the time zone's UTC offset on the day the schedule was set

status.title: Status
status.description: pending (the charger has not answered), accepted, rejected (by the charger or the charging core), unknown (dispatch outcome unknown), no_reply, cleared, replaced (OCPP 1.6: a later profile took its slot) or ended (its session is over)

charger_status.title: Charger Status
charger_status.description: The charger's own answer to SetChargingProfile: Accepted, Rejected, NotSupported (OCPP 1.6) or CallError

error.title: Error
error.description: Why a rejected profile was refused: {code, message}

purpose.title: Purpose
purpose.description: Clear every profile of this purpose on the station, the API's and any other

connector_id.title: Connector Id
connector_id.description: Only those of this connector (its EVSE on OCPP 2.x); omit for every connector and the station

stack_level.title: Stack Level
stack_level.description: Only those at this stack level

connector_id.title: Connector Id
connector_id.description: Connector resource ID returned by the station API, not an OCPP connector number

transaction_id.title: Transaction Id
transaction_id.description: Transaction resource ID returned by the transactions API

location.title: Location
location.description: update_firmware: https URL the charger downloads the firmware from. upload_diagnostics: https URL the charger uploads its diagnostics or log file to. No credentials in the URL; a query string is passed on but never returned.

retrieve_at.title: Retrieve At
retrieve_at.description: update_firmware: ISO 8601 time with offset after which the charger downloads the firmware; omit for now

retries.title: Retries
retries.description: update_firmware and upload_diagnostics: how often the charger retries a failed download or upload

from.title: From
from.description: upload_diagnostics: ISO 8601 time with offset of the oldest entries wanted

to.title: To
to.description: upload_diagnostics: ISO 8601 time with offset of the newest entries wanted

force.title: Force
force.description: update_firmware: send even while a transaction is active (the charger may interrupt it). Signed-in Ivora platform administrators only, never an API key

connector_id.title: Connector Id
connector_id.description: The connector resource ID (its EVSE on OCPP 2.x); omit for the whole station

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: The unit the charger reports in; omit for its own choice

key.title: Key
key.description: OCPP 1.6 configuration key, for example HeartbeatInterval

component.title: Component
component.description: OCPP 2.x component name, for example OCPPCommCtrlr

evse_number.title: Evse Number
evse_number.description: OCPP 2.x: the EVSE the component belongs to (the station's evse_number), if any

variable.title: Variable
variable.description: OCPP 2.x variable name, for example HeartbeatInterval

attribute_type.title: Attribute Type
attribute_type.description: OCPP 2.x attribute; OCPP 1.6 keys have only Actual

value.title: Value
value.description: New value as text. OCPP 1.6 allows 500 characters, OCPP 2.x 1000. Never logged.

allow_protected.title: Allow Protected
allow_protected.description: Deprecated and ignored: protected keys need stations:admin instead

confirm_connection_change.title: Confirm Connection Change
confirm_connection_change.description: Required (true) to change a connection key: WebSocketURL, OCPPID, SecurityProfile, the central system URL or charger identity, the OCPP 2.x NetworkConfiguration component and the SecurityCtrlr/OCPPCommCtrlr network variables. A wrong value disconnects the charger from Ivora and only someone at the charger can fix it then; 422 connection_change_unconfirmed otherwise

ConfigurationChange.title: ConfigurationChange
ConfigurationChange.description: One key on OCPP 1.6 (key), or one variable on OCPP 2.0.1/2.1 (component and variable).

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: different: both have it with other values; missing: Ivora has not recorded it.

key.title: Key
key.description: OCPP 1.6 key, or Component[.instance]/Variable[.instance] on OCPP 2.x

value.title: Value
value.description: Last value the core recorded; null for sensitive keys, which are never returned

readonly.title: Readonly
readonly.description: The charger reports the key read-only (OCPP 1.6 readonly, OCPP 2.x mutability ReadOnly)

sensitive.title: Sensitive
sensitive.description: The value is a secret: never returned and not changeable here (use PUT .../credentials for the station password)

protected.title: Protected
protected.description: Changing this key needs stations:admin: it is not a standard OCPP key every tenant key may change (it could disconnect the charger, weaken its security, or is a vendor key)

connection.title: Connection
connection.description: A connection key (where the charger connects, as whom or how securely): protected, and a change also needs confirm_connection_change

status.title: Status
status.description: OCPP 2.x: the charger's status for the latest SetVariables of this attribute, as the core recorded it

source.title: Source
source.description: get_configuration: OCPP 1.6 keys from the charger's GetConfiguration and accepted changes; device_model: OCPP 2.x variables from its reports and SetVariables

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why it was not checked: no_baseline, not_recorded (Ivora has not read the charger's configuration yet), nothing_compared, too_many_items (Ivora recorded more than 2,000 items for the charger), protocol_unsupported.

skipped.title: Skipped
skipped.description: Keys not compared: ignored, secret, deciding where the charger connects (its URL and identity differ on purpose), or ambiguous.

ambiguous.title: Ambiguous
ambiguous.description: OCPP 2.x labels skipped because Ivora recorded them with different values on more than one EVSE or attribute. Only the Actual attribute is compared.

type.title: Type
type.description: OCPP 2.x connector type, for example IEC62196T1 (J1772), IEC62196T1COMBO (CCS1) or CHAdeMO.

max_power_w.title: Max Power W
max_power_w.description: Maximum power in W (watts), for example 7400 or 150000.

ConnectorInput.title: ConnectorInput
ConnectorInput.description: A new connector's physical description; omitted fields stay unknown. Its tariff is set as for any connector (tariffs).

id.title: Id
id.description: Connector resource ID; commands, bills and connector routes take it.

number.title: Number
number.description: OCPP 1.6 connector number on the station.

evse_connector_number.title: Evse Connector Number
evse_connector_number.description: OCPP 2.x connector number on its EVSE.

type.title: Type
type.description: OCPP 2.x connector type, null when unknown.

tariff_id.title: Tariff Id
tariff_id.description: The tariff new sessions on this connector are priced by; null when none is assigned.

previous_tariff_id.title: Previous Tariff Id
previous_tariff_id.description: Set by a change: the tariff the connector had before; null when it had none or on a read.

changed.title: Changed
changed.description: Set by a change: false when the connector already had this assignment.

tariff_id.title: Tariff Id
tariff_id.description: An active tariff in this tenant (id from the tariff routes).

type.title: Type
type.description: OCPP 2.x connector type, for example IEC62196T1 (J1772), IEC62196T1COMBO (CCS1) or CHAdeMO.

max_power_w.title: Max Power W
max_power_w.description: Maximum power in W (watts), for example 7400 or 150000.

scopes.title: Scopes
scopes.description: The scopes the app requests, as the consent screen lists them.

revision.title: Revision
revision.description: Send this as consent_revision when installing.

installed.description: The active install, when the app is already installed here.

can_install.title: Can Install
can_install.description: Whether you may install this app in this project: a team owner, admin or developer (only an owner or admin for another team's first_party app), or an Ivora administrator.

reason_required.title: Reason Required
reason_required.description: True for Ivora administrators outside the project's team: installing needs a reason, which the project's audit trail keeps.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether the team's projects reach the CSMS (chargers, sessions, billing and the project API). A team that is not enabled keeps Data Tools and can ask for access (Request access in the dashboard); until Ivora finishes moving personal access grants to teams, its members keep read access to its existing projects.

enabled_via.title: Enabled Via
enabled_via.description: staff: Ivora enabled the team. inherited: the team was created by the owner of an enabled team in good standing. self_serve: the owner enabled it in the self-serve CSMS trial (a charger cap and review-gated features until Ivora reviews it). null while not enabled.

inherited_from.title: Inherited From
inherited_from.description: The enabled team it inherited from (enabled_via inherited).

self_serve.title: Self Serve
self_serve.description: The team's place in the self-serve CSMS trial (GET /v1/teams/{team_id}/self-serve), null when it never enrolled.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why the access last changed.

exponent.title: Exponent
exponent.description: Decimal places of the currency (ISO 4217): amounts named *_minor are major units × 10^exponent; 2 is cents.

min_charge_minor.title: Min Charge Minor
min_charge_minor.description: The smallest amount a card payment collects in this currency.

hold_range.description: The authorization hold a tariff may set for managed card bills, inclusive.

default_hold_minor.title: Default Hold Minor
default_hold_minor.description: A suggested authorization hold for a new tariff.

period.title: Period
period.description: The current UTC calendar month, YYYY-MM.

period_start.title: Period Start
period_start.description: Start of the month in UTC (inclusive), such as 2026-10-01T00:00:00+00:00.

period_end.title: Period End
period_end.description: Start of the next month in UTC (exclusive).

billable_from.title: Billable From
billable_from.description: When the team's usage starts to be billed: the later of the usage fee's release and the end of the team's grace period. Sessions that ended before it are never invoiced.

energy_kwh.title: Energy Kwh
energy_kwh.description: kWh of the project's completed charging sessions that ended this month (each session's whole energy, as the invoice counts it), a decimal string as the core records kWh, such as "6.941"; "0" without sessions. Sessions still running count when they end.

billable_kwh.title: Billable Kwh
billable_kwh.description: The part of energy_kwh that ended at or after billable_from: what the invoice bills.

held_transactions.title: Held Transactions
held_transactions.description: Billable sessions with an implausible reading (negative or above 1000 kWh), left out of the estimate; they hold the team's invoice until Ivora corrects them.

invoiced.title: Invoiced
invoiced.description: False when this usage is not invoiced: see not_invoiced_reason; estimated_minor is then 0.

not_invoiced_reason.title: Not Invoiced Reason
not_invoiced_reason.description: internal: an Ivora internal team. bench: Ivora's test bench project. waived: the team's fee is waived. grace: the team's grace period runs until billable_from.

rate_cents_per_kwh.title: Rate Cents Per Kwh
rate_cents_per_kwh.description: The project's effective rate the estimate uses.

usage_minor.title: Usage Minor
usage_minor.description: The project's invoice line so far in US cents: billable_kwh x rate_cents_per_kwh, rounded half up.

discount_percent.title: Discount Percent
discount_percent.description: The team's discount the estimate applies.

discount_minor.title: Discount Minor
discount_minor.description: usage_minor x discount_percent / 100, rounded half up. The invoice rounds the discount once over all of the team's projects, so it can differ by a cent.

estimated_minor.title: Estimated Minor
estimated_minor.description: Estimated usage fee so far this month in US cents: usage_minor - discount_minor. The team's whole month (every project and any carried balance) is GET /v1/tenants/{tenant_id}/billing-profile/usage; the monthly invoice is final.

as_of.title: As Of
as_of.description: When the usage was read from the CSMS; reads are cached up to 60 seconds.

kwh.title: Kwh
kwh.description: Cumulative energy charged by then, kWh.

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: Hostname of the project's ACTIVE custom OCPP domain.

url.title: Url
url.description: This station's OCPP WebSocket URL on that domain: the domain's connection_url_template with {station_name} replaced by the station's OCPP name (p<tenant_id>-<charger_id> for a per-project station, nothing appended).

status.title: Status
status.description: Always active: pending, verified-only and disabled domains, and active ones the edge would refuse (verification older than 24 hours or an expired certificate), are not listed.

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: location: the default of one location; project: the project's default.

location_id.title: Location Id
location_id.description: The location, when scope is location.

tariff_id.title: Tariff Id
tariff_id.description: The default tariff; null when none is set.

previous_tariff_id.title: Previous Tariff Id
previous_tariff_id.description: Set by a change: the default before; null when there was none or on a read.

changed.title: Changed
changed.description: Set by a change: false when the default already was this tariff.

tariff_id.title: Tariff Id
tariff_id.description: An active tariff in this tenant (id from the tariff routes).

confirm_currency.title: Confirm Currency
confirm_currency.description: Required (true) when the tariff's currency is not the project's default_currency; without it such a tariff is refused with 409 tariff_currency_mismatch.

status.title: Status
status.description: dropped: a station.ocpp_message the endpoint missed under backpressure (last_error); never attempted.

status.title: Status
status.description: matched: an adapter matches the charger's vendor and model. assigned: Ivora staff assigned one. no_adapter: none drives the screen, so it shows no payment QR or price from Ivora; use a printed QR. lost: none drives it now although the charger had one (previous_adapter), for example on the station record it had before moving to its project URL.

adapter.title: Adapter
adapter.description: Template ID that drives the screen now, as display.adapter; null for no_adapter and lost.

previous_adapter.title: Previous Adapter
previous_adapter.description: Template name the charger had before when it differs from adapter: carried from the station record this one replaced, else the last one pushed to this station, else an assignment that no longer applies.

compatible.title: Compatible
compatible.description: Template names Ivora staff can assign to this station for its protocol, the current adapter (else previous_adapter) first. Empty before the charger reports its protocol.

state.title: State
state.description: applied: the charging core dispatched the latest push, which does not confirm what the screen shows (the generic OCPP 2.x adapters cannot tell whether a charger has a screen). unsupported: no adapter drives this charger's screen; use a printed QR.

shown.title: Shown
shown.description: Whether the last applied push sent the QR (false after a clear); null before the first push.

revision.title: Revision
revision.description: Desired revision the last successful push carried.

last_error.title: Last Error
last_error.description: Error code of the last failed push, for example dispatch_unconfirmed or template_render_failed.

qr.title: Qr
qr.description: https URL the screen encodes as a QR, usually your checkout page for this EVSE. No customer data or secrets.

show_price.title: Show Price
show_price.description: Also show the price where the adapter supports it: the tariff_id tariff when set, else the EVSE's connector tariff.

tariff_id.title: Tariff Id
tariff_id.description: A tariff in this tenant whose price the screen shows, usually the one your application bills with. Omit to use the EVSE's connector tariff.

visibility.title: Visibility
visibility.description: idle shows the QR only while the connector is payable, on adapters that can clear; always keeps it up.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Let the generic OCPP 1.6 California Pricing adapter write the tariff's price text to this charger. An explicit choice always wins over this environment's default.

adapter.title: Adapter
adapter.description: builtin-ocpp16-california-pricing, or the vendor template that owns the screen (status vendor_adapter), or null.

status.title: Status
status.description: active: Ivora writes the tariff's price text to the keys in writes. not_detected: no configuration has been read yet (ask the charger with POST .../configuration/refresh). unsupported: the charger reports no key Ivora may write (level none, only non-English DefaultPriceText, or a price key whose value is not the spec's JSON: last_error default_price_format). refused: the charger refused a write (see refusal); nothing more is written until the setting is written. off: switched off for this station, or no explicit choice and this environment's default is off. vendor_adapter: a vendor display adapter or an Ivora assignment owns this screen and wins. not_booted: the charger has not reported its protocol. protocol_unsupported: California Pricing is an OCPP 1.6 extension.

level.title: Level
level.description: What the charger's own configuration reports: price_text when DefaultPrice or a DefaultPriceText,<language> key is reported, full when CustomDisplayCostAndPrice is true (running and final cost then follow the running cost setting), none otherwise; null before detection.

detected_at.title: Detected At
detected_at.description: When the level was last read from the configuration the charging core recorded.

configuration_keys.title: Configuration Keys
configuration_keys.description: The extension's standard keys the charger reported.

writes.title: Writes
writes.description: The keys Ivora writes: DefaultPrice and DefaultPriceText,<English language>; never a read-only or vendor key.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: The explicit choice, else this environment's default (source default).

price_text.title: Price Text
price_text.description: The price text of the last push the charging core accepted, for example "CA$0.47/kWh incl. GST".

sent_at.title: Sent At
sent_at.description: When the charging core accepted the last push.

applied_at.title: Applied At
applied_at.description: When the charger accepted every key of the last push.

last_error.title: Last Error
last_error.description: Why the last push failed or was held back, for example no_tariff, price_hidden (every display hides the price), tariffs_differ (the EVSEs' prices differ; DefaultPrice is charger-wide), complex_tariff, tariff_not_found, default_price_format (a reported price key holds a value that is not the spec's JSON), station_offline, dispatch_unconfirmed, charger_rejected or no_charger_reply.

key.title: Key
key.description: The configuration key the charger refused.

status.title: Status
status.description: The charger's ChangeConfiguration.conf status, or CallError when it answered with an OCPP error.

at.title: At
at.description: When the charging core received the refusal.

id.title: Id
id.description: <station_id>-<evse_number>

tariff_id.title: Tariff Id
tariff_id.description: Tariff the screen's price comes from; null uses the EVSE's connector tariff.

revision.title: Revision
revision.description: Increments whenever qr, show_price, visibility or tariff_id changes.

adapter.title: Adapter
adapter.description: Display adapter template that last resolved for this charger, for example builtin-rcd.

clear.title: Clear
clear.description: The adapter can take the QR off the screen.

id.title: Id
id.description: <station_id>-<evse_number>

tariff_id.title: Tariff Id
tariff_id.description: Tariff the screen's price comes from; null uses the EVSE's connector tariff.

revision.title: Revision
revision.description: Increments whenever qr, show_price, visibility or tariff_id changes.

adapter.title: Adapter
adapter.description: Display adapter template that last resolved for this charger, for example builtin-rcd.

clear.title: Clear
clear.description: The adapter can take the QR off the screen.

warnings.title: Warnings
warnings.description: Advisory only; the display is stored and pushed as set. Empty when the connector tariffs could not be read.

code.title: Code
code.description: display_tariff_differs: the screen shows the tariff_id price while this EVSE's connectors bill another tariff.

connector_tariff_ids.title: Connector Tariff Ids
connector_tariff_ids.description: Tariffs this EVSE's connectors bill with.

displayed.title: Displayed
displayed.description: False until the charger shows a RunningCost or FinalCost stamped after this session's transaction started.

status.title: Status
status.description: Running, or Finished after FinalCost.

cost.title: Cost
cost.description: Major currency units as the charger stores them (it truncates to its decimals).

cost_minor.title: Cost Minor
cost_minor.description: The same amount in units of 10^-cost_decimals.

meter_wh.title: Meter Wh
meter_wh.description: The meter reading of the cost message, in Wh (an OCPP 1.6 register).

status.title: Status
status.description: pending_dns until both DNS records check out; dns_verified once they do; active after the edge worker issued the certificate; disabled by the tenant. activation_error explains a stalled activation.

ready.title: Ready
ready.description: Active, DNS rechecked within 24 hours and an unexpired certificate.

logo_url.title: Logo Url
logo_url.description: Null when the tenant set a name but no logo: show the name as text.

terms_url.title: Terms Url
terms_url.description: The operator's terms and conditions page (https), or null: link checkout's terms checkbox to it, else name the operator's terms without a link.

checkout_origin.title: Checkout Origin
checkout_origin.description: Origin of checkout links for this brand: the project's checkout_domain while it is ready, else the default payment host. Checkout links encode <checkout_origin>/checkout/<station>-<evse>.

source.title: Source
source.description: How the brand was chosen: the payment domain the page is served on, the charger's tenant, or Ivora's default.

tariff_id.title: Tariff Id
tariff_id.description: The tariff that prices new sessions on this connector now, by the pricing order: the connector's own assigned tariff, else its location's default tariff, else the project's default tariff; null when none applies.

source.title: Source
source.description: Where tariff_id comes from: connector (its own assigned tariff), location (the default tariff of the station's location), project (the project's default tariff) or none (nothing applies, so a bill needs an explicit tariff_id).

source_id.title: Source Id
source_id.description: The location's ID when source is location; null otherwise.

tariff.description: The applying tariff in full (prices, elements, rules, pricing_summary, tariff_alt_text), null when none. Its archived flag is true when the assigned tariff was archived since: it still applies to the connector but starts no new bill.

code.title: Code
code.description: Stable machine-readable condition, for example station_offline or idempotency_key_reused. Generic codes (not_found, conflict, invalid_request) remain for conditions without a specific code.

details.title: Details
details.description: Optional structured context such as operation_id or resource_id.

retained.title: Retained
retained.description: true when transactions reference the EVSE: the core keeps it marked removed, so their history keeps its EVSE and connectors; it leaves every station read and its number stays taken.

connectors.title: Connectors
connectors.description: Each connector of the EVSE with the tariff that applies to it.

station_id.title: Station Id
station_id.description: One of your stations, as /v1 identifies it.

evse_number.title: Evse Number
evse_number.description: The EVSE's evse_number on the station, the number in Ivora's generated ID <party>*E<station>*<evse>; an EVSE without one is keyed by its EVSE ID in the charging core.

evse_id.title: Evse Id
evse_id.description: The eMI3 EVSE ID the EVSE was published with before, with separators, such as US*XYZ*E123: your own party, E, then your ID. Letters are read in upper case.

evse_number.title: Evse Number
evse_number.description: The EVSE's number on the station (OCPP 2.x evseId); omit for the next free number.

physical_reference.title: Physical Reference
physical_reference.description: Label printed on the EVSE, for example A or 2 (OCPI physical_reference).

connectors.title: Connectors
connectors.description: Its connectors, numbered 1, 2, ... on the EVSE; one undescribed connector when omitted.

evse_uid.title: Evse Uid
evse_uid.description: The OCPI EVSE uid partners command.

evse_id.title: Evse Id
evse_id.description: The EVSE ID partners show; null while you have no OCPI settings.

ready.title: Ready
ready.description: Every check passes: published, every connector's tariff prices its charge records, the charger online, a plug-in seen (OCPP 1.6 Preparing or 2.x Occupied) and a protocol Ivora starts remotely.

physical_reference.title: Physical Reference
physical_reference.description: Label printed on the EVSE (OCPI physical_reference).

period_begin.title: Period Begin
period_begin.description: RFC 3339 date-time with an offset or Z; returned in UTC.

point.title: Point
point.description: Where the dashboard shows the app: a project tab, a panel on a station or a session, an overview widget, or an action (a button on a station or session that opens the app).

path.title: Path
path.description: The page on the app's UI origin, starting with /.

title.title: Title
title.description: The tab, panel or action label; required except for widgets.

target.title: Target
target.description: For an action: the page it appears on.

size.title: Size
size.description: For a widget: its size on the overview grid.

source.title: Source
source.description: Always csms: usage comes from the charging core. Optional.

pricing_group.title: Pricing Group
pricing_group.description: The driver's member or RFID group, for the tariff's group discounts. Frozen with the tariff; ignored by simple tariffs.

merchant_validation.title: Merchant Validation
merchant_validation.description: A merchant validation code, for the tariff's merchant validation rule. Frozen with the tariff.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Your own key/value pairs (strings), such as a site host or a contract ID: at most 50 keys of 1-40 characters of A-Z, a-z, 0-9, underscore, period and hyphen, values of at most 500 characters. Never secrets or personal data. Never published to OCPI roaming partners. Stays writable after creation (PATCH); the station's and location's metadata are snapshot separately when the bill is created (station_metadata, location_metadata).

application_reference.title: Application Reference
application_reference.description: Unique booking/session reference within your tenant. No customer data or secrets.

processor.title: Processor
processor.description: Descriptive payment integration name. No adapter is called.

payment_reference.title: Payment Reference
payment_reference.description: Stable external payment reference, unique per tenant, processor and merchant.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Your own key/value pairs (strings), such as a site host or a contract ID: at most 50 keys of 1-40 characters of A-Z, a-z, 0-9, underscore, period and hyphen, values of at most 500 characters. Never secrets or personal data. Never published to OCPI roaming partners. The session's bill's metadata (a session is its bill); writable with PATCH.

station_metadata.title: Station Metadata
station_metadata.description: The station's metadata as it was when the bill was created, copied once and never changed afterwards, so historical attribution survives later edits. {} when it had none (or had no station).

location_metadata.title: Location Metadata
location_metadata.description: The location's metadata as it was when the bill was created, copied once and never changed afterwards, so historical attribution survives later edits. {} when it had none (or had no location).

usage.description: Live matched usage while charging; a final snapshot once completed. Null before a transaction is observed and on canceled sessions.

funding_confirmed.title: Funding Confirmed
funding_confirmed.description: Your backend attests it has authorized funding. Ivora cannot independently verify this assertion or enforce the processor's hold.

limit.description: Optional: the platform stops charging when the session reaches this energy, or this amount at the bill's per-kWh rate.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: rcd: residual current (GroundFailure); diode: a diode failure; error-e: control pilot state E. Needs the EV plugged in; unplug clears it.

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Pass as before for the next, older page; null on the last page.

id.title: Id
id.description: fault_id in station.fault_opened and station.fault_cleared events.

connector_id.title: Connector Id
connector_id.description: Connector resource ID; null when the charger reported the fault for the whole station.

error_code.title: Error Code
error_code.description: OCPP 1.6 errorCode other than NoError; null for an OCPP 2.x Faulted status without one.

ocpp_status.title: Ocpp Status
ocpp_status.description: The status the charger reported with the fault, as sent.

opened_at.title: Opened At
opened_at.description: The charger's timestamp of the notification that opened the fault, else when Ivora observed it.

station_name.title: Station Name
station_name.description: The station's OCPP connection name: the Basic user name.

password.title: Password
password.description: The station's Ivora connection password. Keep it in memory or the proxy's own secret store; never log it.

changed_at.title: Changed At
changed_at.description: When this password was set or last rotated.

transaction_id.title: Transaction Id
transaction_id.description: The completed transaction's resource ID. Usage is read from the charging core, never accepted from the caller.

status.title: Status
status.description: fail blocks going live; warn is worth fixing first; n/a: the check does not apply to this project.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: One line on the check's result.

fix.title: Fix
fix.description: How to fix it, when the status is warn or fail; null otherwise.

dashboard_path.title: Dashboard Path
dashboard_path.description: The dashboard page that fixes it, relative to the project (for example settings/payouts).

counts.description: Items per status, every item included.

items.title: Items
items.description: The items that did not pass, worst first (at most 100); counts cover every item.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: What the item is: a station, a connector (id station_id/connector number), a location, a branding field, an API key, an installed app, a QR sticker or a payment domain.

name.title: Name
name.description: The item's name as the dashboard shows it, when it has one.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: One line on why the item has this status.

overall.title: Overall
overall.description: not_ready while any check fails; ready_with_warnings while any warns; else ready.

payment_mode.title: Payment Mode
payment_mode.description: Whether this environment takes live card payments (test: no real card is charged).

id.title: Id
id.description: Your name for this discount; shown on quote and bill adjustments.

groups.title: Groups

rate_limit_per_minute.description: Ivora administrators only: the install's own requests a minute (default 120).

status.description: running while a charger is still open; then failed if any failed or expired (a rollback refused as busy too; a batch retries a busy move instead), else succeeded.

paced.title: Paced

counts.title: Counts
counts.description: Chargers per outcome (open for those still running).

not_before.description: When the runner may apply it: now, or later for a paced mass rollback.

outcome.description: null while open. applied, failed, superseded or expired: the proxy's result (or the rollback's expiry). skipped: not rolled back by this job (detail).

detail.title: Detail

tenant_id.title: Tenant Id
tenant_id.description: CSMS keys default to your automatically assigned tenant. An explicit tenant is checked against your current access. The key stays bound to that tenant.

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Pass as before for the next, older page; null on the last page.

kind.description: session: a charging session whose start reached Ivora late; orphan_stop: a stop for a transaction neither Ivora nor the charging core knew, kept as an event with no session.

status.title: Status
status.description: recorded, or refused (refused_reason): a session that started before the station was registered in the project, more than 30 days before Ivora received it, or while the station was in shadow mode. Either way the charging core answered the charger with a CallResult (start_answer, stop_answer), unless it answered a CallError.

refused_reason.title: Refused Reason
refused_reason.description: before_commissioning (takes precedence over older_than_window), older_than_window or shadow; null unless refused.

late.title: Late
late.description: True when the start (a stop, for an orphan stop) reached Ivora 15 minutes or more after the charger's timestamp, or the charger marked it offline.

offline.title: Offline
offline.description: An OCPP 2.x start the charger sent with offline true.

charger_transaction_id.title: Charger Transaction Id
charger_transaction_id.description: The transaction ID the charger used (0 after a start the charging core refused).

transaction_id.title: Transaction Id
transaction_id.description: The transaction resource the charging core recorded for it, when it recorded one; else null and this record is the only one of the session.

bill_id.title: Bill Id
bill_id.description: The bill whose charging token the session used, if any.

bill_status.title: Bill Status
bill_status.description: That bill's status (open, final, ...); null without a bill.

stopped_at.title: Stopped At
stopped_at.description: The charger's stop time; null until the stop arrives.

received_at.title: Received At
received_at.description: When Ivora received the start (the stop, for an orphan stop).

meter_start_wh.title: Meter Start Wh
meter_start_wh.description: Energy register at the start in Wh, as the charger reported it.

meter_stop_wh.title: Meter Stop Wh
meter_stop_wh.description: Energy register at the stop in Wh.

energy_wh.title: Energy Wh
energy_wh.description: meter_stop_wh minus meter_start_wh, when both are known.

start_answer.title: Start Answer
start_answer.description: What the charging core answered the charger's start: its idTagInfo/idTokenInfo status (Accepted, Invalid, Expired, Blocked, ConcurrentTx, ...), Acknowledged, or CallError and its code; null when no answer was found.

automatic_billing.title: Automatic Billing
automatic_billing.description: True when the bill (bill_id) settles the transaction the charging core saved for this session, within that bill's authorised hold: an OCPP 2.x start (saved even when offline) or an accepted 1.6 start on a bill's charging token. False otherwise; a session the core refused (transaction_id null) reaches no bill, and an operator may bill it by hand.

status.title: Status
status.description: releasing: the simulated EV is being unplugged before the charger is freed.

idle_expires_at.title: Idle Expires At
idle_expires_at.description: While active: when the idle sweep ends the session unless it is read or changed before.

expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description: While active: the lease's maximum age (30 minutes by default), after which the sweep stops, settles and releases however active the session is.

release_reason.title: Release Reason
release_reason.description: settled, canceled, idle, max_age, operator, payment_canceled or stop_timeout.

Each tariff names its own currency and a bill takes its tariff's; this is the project's default, not a conversion. Ivora's platform fee stays in USD. Defaults to USD.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Your own key/value pairs (strings), such as a site host or a contract ID: at most 50 keys of 1-40 characters of A-Z, a-z, 0-9, underscore, period and hyphen, values of at most 500 characters. Never secrets or personal data. Never published to OCPI roaming partners. On create, sets the pairs; on PATCH, merges them into the stored ones: a key sent as "" or null is deleted, other keys keep their values.
