payment_methods.title: Payment Methods
payment_methods.description: How an invoice can be paid: us_bank_account (ACH debit), customer_balance (bank transfer: ACH credit or wire), acss_debit (Canadian pre-authorized debit in USD), card. Every invoice is in USD.

collection.title: Collection
collection.description: auto_debit: the verified bank account is debited on the due date. invoice_only: pay each invoice by its due date.

ProjectInvoiceTerms.title: ProjectInvoiceTerms
ProjectInvoiceTerms.description: An enterprise team's invoice terms as a project's billing profile shows them (no contacts or legal details).

key.title: Key
key.description: The secret; copy it now, it cannot be retrieved again.

scopes.title: Scopes
scopes.description: Project scopes only, each one you hold on the project yourself, or migration:import (network imports; the team's owners and admins and Ivora administrators only).

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: The key's first 16 characters, to recognise it; the secret is shown only when it is created.

api_version.title: Api Version
api_version.description: The dated API version the key is pinned to.

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: project: the key belongs to the project, not to the person who made it.

created_by.title: Created By
created_by.description: user:<user_id> (or key:<id>) that made the key; null for keys made before project-owned keys.

migrated.title: Migrated
migrated.description: True for a personal key moved to the project by the key migration.

rate_limit_per_minute.title: Rate Limit Per Minute
rate_limit_per_minute.description: A staff-set limit; null takes the default of 1,200 requests a minute.

id.title: Id
id.description: The project's tenant ID, used in /v1/tenants/{tenant_id} routes.

team_id.title: Team Id
team_id.description: The team (billing team) the project belongs to; null before its first billing change.

default_currency.title: Default Currency
default_currency.description: The project's default currency (ISO 4217); USD unless it chose another.

currency_display.title: Currency Display
currency_display.description: How charger screens and running cost messages show the project's money: symbol (the default) shows the currency symbol, such as CA$0.35/kWh; code shows the dollar sign and the currency code, such as $0.35 CAD/kWh. USD price text on charger screens is unchanged by either (0.35 USD/kWh).

charger_urls.title: Charger Urls
charger_urls.description: Per-project charger URLs are on (the default where offered, unless staff turned them off): register stations with charger_id; chargers connect at connection_base_url followed by their charger ID.

connection_base_url.title: Connection Base Url
connection_base_url.description: The project URL for chargers, such as wss://ocpp.ivoracharge.co/18/, while charger_urls is on.

checkout_domain.title: Checkout Domain
checkout_domain.description: The hostname of one of the project's own active payment domains that checkout links and QR codes use, such as payment.example.com; null: Ivora's default payment host. Ivora's default checkout URLs keep working either way.

qr_domain.title: Qr Domain
qr_domain.description: The hostname of one of the project's own active QR domains that new stickers encode (a stable redirect name that survives later payment-domain changes); null: stickers use checkout_domain, else Ivora's default.

sticker_url_template.title: Sticker Url Template
sticker_url_template.description: What new QR stickers and cards for the project's EVSEs encode now: https://<qr_domain>/{station_name} while qr_domain is ready, else <checkout origin>/checkout/{station_name}-{evse_number} on checkout_domain while it is ready, else on Ivora's default payment host.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Your own key/value pairs (strings), such as a site host or a contract ID: at most 50 keys of 1-40 characters of A-Z, a-z, 0-9, underscore, period and hyphen, values of at most 500 characters. Never secrets or personal data. Never published to OCPI roaming partners.

name.title: Name
name.description: The project's new name, as the dashboard and the charging core show it.

default_currency.title: Default Currency
default_currency.description: The project's default currency, an ISO 4217 code from GET /v1/currencies (else 422 currency_unsupported). Each tariff names its own currency and a bill takes its tariff's; this is the project's default, not a conversion. Ivora's platform fee stays in USD. Existing tariffs and bills keep their currency.

currency_display.title: Currency Display
currency_display.description: How charger screens and running cost messages show the project's money: symbol (the default) shows the currency symbol, such as CA$0.35/kWh; code shows the dollar sign and the currency code, such as $0.35 CAD/kWh. USD price text on charger screens is unchanged by either (0.35 USD/kWh).

checkout_domain.title: Checkout Domain
checkout_domain.description: The hostname of one of the project's own active payment domains that checkout links and QR codes use, such as payment.example.com; null: Ivora's default payment host. Ivora's default checkout URLs keep working either way. Sent as null, returns to Ivora's default; left out, unchanged.

qr_domain.title: Qr Domain
qr_domain.description: The hostname of one of the project's own active QR domains that new stickers encode (a stable redirect name that survives later payment-domain changes); null: stickers use checkout_domain, else Ivora's default. Sent as null, returns to that fallback; left out, unchanged.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Your own key/value pairs (strings), such as a site host or a contract ID: at most 50 keys of 1-40 characters of A-Z, a-z, 0-9, underscore, period and hyphen, values of at most 500 characters. Never secrets or personal data. Never published to OCPI roaming partners. On create, sets the pairs; on PATCH, merges them into the stored ones: a key sent as "" or null is deleted, other keys keep their values.

ProjectUpdate.title: ProjectUpdate
ProjectUpdate.description: A new name, default currency, metadata to merge, or any of them.

last_at.title: Last At
last_at.description: When the partner last made an authenticated request for this module.

requests_24h.title: Requests 24H
requests_24h.description: Requests in the last 24 hours that the message log still holds (at most its newest rows).

status.title: Status
status.description: pending_dns until both DNS records check out; dns_verified once they do; active after the edge worker issued the certificate; disabled by the tenant. activation_error explains a stalled activation.

ready.title: Ready
ready.description: Active, DNS rechecked within 24 hours and an unexpired certificate.

scan_url_template.title: Scan Url Template
scan_url_template.description: What a sticker encodes on this hostname: any path is a sticker code (QR redirects).

previous_platform_origins.title: Previous Platform Origins
previous_platform_origins.description: The old platform's https origins a sticker may send drivers to before its charger moves (hostname only, no path). Unicode hostnames are stored in their ASCII (punycode) form.

previous_url_template.title: Previous Url Template
previous_url_template.description: The old platform's page for a sticker without its own previous_url: {code} (the sticker's code), {station_name} or {charger_id}, each percent-encoded, in the path or query of a URL on previous_platform_origins.

default_route.title: Default Route
default_route.description: Where a charger with no recorded flip connects: previous_platform while the network migrates, ivora for chargers that were never anywhere else.

website_origins.title: Website Origins
website_origins.description: Your own website's https origins (hostname only) whose pages may call the website lookup from the browser (CORS). Omitted or null keeps the stored list. Only Ivora staff add an origin, once they checked the project runs that website; the project may remove one.

ivora_origin.title: Ivora Origin
ivora_origin.description: The Ivora checkout origin, always on the allowlist: the ready payment domain, else Ivora's payment host. Null when that is not a public https origin (a local profile): scans then show the not-ready page.

scan_url_template.title: Scan Url Template
scan_url_template.description: The scan URL on Ivora's own host, for networks without a QR domain.

website_origins.title: Website Origins
website_origins.description: The website origins allowed to call the website lookup from the browser.

lookup_url.title: Lookup Url
lookup_url.description: The website lookup on Ivora's own host: add ?code=<the sticker's code>.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: What the partner needs that the switches cannot do, in one line. Never a token or a password. No control, bidirectional-override or invisible characters.

details.title: Details
details.description: What you saw: the endpoint, the partner's behaviour, an example ID. Never a token or a password. Line breaks and tabs are kept; other control, bidirectional-override and invisible characters are refused.

rule.title: Rule
rule.description: The group discount id, the validation code, or max_session_cost_minor.

location_id.title: Location Id
location_id.description: Optional: a location of this tenant whose tax lines (PUT .../locations/{location_id}/tax) apply, as they will on a bill for a station there. Omit for the price before any location's tax.

element.title: Element
element.description: Index of the element that priced this line.

quantity.title: Quantity
quantity.description: Decimal quantity in unit (rounded to 6 places for display).

exact_minor.title: Exact Minor
exact_minor.description: Unrounded amount, minor units (decimal string, 6 places).

amount_minor.title: Amount Minor
amount_minor.description: Amount rounded half up to integer minor units, for display. total_minor rounds the exact sum once, so line amounts may differ from it by rounding.

tariff_id.title: Tariff Id
tariff_id.description: The stored tariff quoted; null for a simulation.

pricing_version.title: Pricing Version
pricing_version.description: energy-v1: a simple tariff (kWh × rate, unchanged); elements-v1: elements and rules.

subtotal_minor.title: Subtotal Minor
subtotal_minor.description: The elements' exact sum rounded half up, before rules.

total_minor.title: Total Minor
total_minor.description: Integer minor units: the exact subtotal after rules, rounded half up once, plus the location's tax lines when they apply (tax). Bills finalize with this same calculation.

tariff_alt_text.title: Tariff Alt Text
tariff_alt_text.description: The tariff's driver-facing descriptions, for receipts.

idle_free_seconds.title: Idle Free Seconds
idle_free_seconds.description: With idle_grace_minutes: the idle seconds that were free; absent otherwise.

activity.description: Bills on complex tariffs only: the charging and idle time the bill was priced over. Null on quotes, simulations and simple tariffs (which price kWh only).

tax.description: With a location's tax lines (location_id on quotes, the station's location on bills): the tax lines, net and total. Absent without tax.

net_minor.title: Net Minor
net_minor.description: The price before tax: total_minor minus tax_minor.

tax_minor.title: Tax Minor
tax_minor.description: The sum of the lines' amount_minor.

total_minor.title: Total Minor
total_minor.description: What the driver pays, tax included; the quote's and bill's total_minor.

base_minor.title: Base Minor
base_minor.description: percent lines: the exact amount taxed, minor units (decimal string, 6 places); null for per_kwh.

quantity_kwh.title: Quantity Kwh
quantity_kwh.description: per_kwh lines: the kWh taxed; null for percent.

exact_minor.title: Exact Minor
exact_minor.description: Unrounded tax, minor units (decimal string, 6 places).

amount_minor.title: Amount Minor
amount_minor.description: The line's tax, rounded half up once.

tariff_id.title: Tariff Id
tariff_id.description: The tariff that prices the connector's charge records: its own, else its location's default, else the project's; null when none applies.

tariff_problem.title: Tariff Problem
tariff_problem.description: Why this connector's sessions would not be priced; null when they would.

ocpp_status.title: Ocpp Status
ocpp_status.description: The status the terminal receives as ocpp_status: the charger's OCPP 1.6 status, or OCPP 2.x Occupied mapped from the session at it (Preparing, Charging, SuspendedEV, SuspendedEVSE or Finishing); Unavailable while the charger is offline.

code.title: Code
code.description: not_published, no_tariff, tariff_not_published, tariff_complex and location_tax also refuse a terminal's start: its charge record would not be priced.

current.title: Current
current.description: The side QR sticker scans follow.

source.title: Source
source.description: site_flip (a site flip record) or charger_route (a charger's own route report or rollback).

period_begin.title: Period Begin
period_begin.description: HH:MM, 24-hour, in the location's time zone.

period_end.title: Period End
period_end.description: HH:MM, after period_begin on the same day. For an overnight opening send two periods (22:00-23:59, then 00:00-06:00 on the next weekday).

name.title: Name
name.description: The migration partner or installer.

start_time.title: Start Time
start_time.description: Local time of day (HH:MM) from which the element applies.

end_time.title: End Time
end_time.description: Local time of day (HH:MM) until which the element applies (exclusive).

start_date.title: Start Date
start_date.description: Local date (YYYY-MM-DD) from which the element applies.

end_date.title: End Date
end_date.description: Local date (YYYY-MM-DD) until which the element applies (exclusive).

min_kwh.title: Min Kwh
min_kwh.description: Energy already charged in the session, kWh (inclusive).

max_kwh.title: Max Kwh
max_kwh.description: Energy already charged in the session, kWh (exclusive).

min_current.title: Min Current
min_current.description: Charging current, A (inclusive). An element restricting current never applies when the current is unknown.

min_power.title: Min Power
min_power.description: Charging power, kW (inclusive). Unknown power matches no power-restricted element.

day_of_week.title: Day Of Week
day_of_week.description: Local days on which the element applies. A time window that wraps midnight belongs to the day it opens (OCPI 2.2.1): FRIDAY with 22:00–02:00 runs from Friday 22:00 to Saturday 02:00.

reservation.title: Reservation
reservation.description: Prices a reservation (TIME: reserved time, FLAT: reservation fee) instead of charging; RESERVATION_EXPIRES only when the reservation expires unused.

Restrictions.title: Restrictions
Restrictions.description:
OCPI 2.2.1 TariffRestrictions, evaluated in the tariff's local time. All given restrictions must hold. min values
are inclusive, max values and end times/dates exclusive; an end_time before its start_time wraps midnight.

resynced.title: Resynced
resynced.description: Dead pushes whose objects are sent again.

messages.title: Messages
messages.description: The newest messages kept per partner.

status.title: Status
status.description: pending_dns until the TXT record checks out; dns_verified while it does (never active: Ivora serves nothing on a return domain); disabled by the tenant.

ready.title: Ready
ready.description: dns_verified and the TXT record rechecked within the last hour: return_url may use this hostname.

return_url_prefix.title: Return Url Prefix
return_url_prefix.description: Every return_url of an API payment on this hostname starts with this prefix.

billed_minor.title: Billed Minor
billed_minor.description: Sum of the final bills' total_minor in minor units of currency. Billed, not collected: captures and refunds are the payment provider's.

basis.title: Basis
basis.description: Revenue is the unified API's final bills only, by finalized_at; never the figures of Ivora's earlier driver checkout.

id_tag.title: Id Tag
id_tag.description: The card's idTag: OCPP 1.6 CiString20, 1-20 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -. The target system authorizes it (Authorize, then StartTransaction once the EV is plugged in, in either order within the charger's ConnectionTimeOut). The same card while charging stops the transaction (StopTransaction reason Local); another card stops it only if the target answers the same parentIdTag. Shown in full only in this lease's own reads.

connector_id.title: Connector Id
connector_id.description: The reader's connector; the bench chargers have one.

kind.title: Kind
kind.description: quirk: a known issue of this model and firmware; plan: a gap in what is known about it

id.title: Id
id.description: The quirk's ID, or model_unknown, firmware_outside_range, profile_missing, energy_source_unknown or pnc_not_checked

severity.title: Severity
severity.description: A quirk's severity; block means the charger should not be moved before its workaround is in place

workaround_kind.title: Workaround Kind
workaround_kind.description: What deals with the quirk: a configuration baseline, an adaptation in Ivora, a rule in the migration proxy, a firmware update, or none (known, no workaround)

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: The quirk's workaround in this project now

name.title: Name
name.description: The station's OCPP connection name (name in station reads), typed to confirm; refused with 409 station_name_mismatch when it is another one (details.name), so a wrong station ID never moves another charger.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why, for the record: kept with the rollback, in the audit log, the proxy's own audit and migration.charger_rolled_back.

location_ids.title: Location Ids
location_ids.description: Or every migration charger at these sites.

batch_id.title: Batch Id
batch_id.description: Or every charger of this batch; the batch then stops for good (rolled_back).

all.title: All
all.description: Or true: every charger of the migration.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why, for the record: kept with each rollback, the audit log and the proxy's own audit.

id.title: Id
id.description: Ivora's identifier of this rollback (mrb_...).

name.title: Name
name.description: The station's OCPP connection name.

status.title: Status
status.description: pending: recorded, waiting for the charger proxy to switch the route. applied_socket_open: the proxy routes the charger to the previous platform, but a connection to Ivora is still open; the proxy closes it and the rollback becomes applied (only then is the event emitted). applied: the proxy routes the charger to the previous platform and no connection to Ivora is open. failed: the proxy could not switch it (detail); ask again, or Ivora on-call rolls it back by hand. superseded: Ivora staff moved the charger to Ivora again after it was asked, so it was not applied. expired: the proxy did not apply it within 24 hours (it was unreachable); Ivora on-call rolls it back by hand.

reconnect.title: Reconnect
reconnect.description: Whether the charger reconnected to the previous platform through the proxy, from the proxy's latest report: waiting_for_switch (pending), reconnecting (within two minutes of the switch), reconnected (a connection to the previous platform is up), not_connected (no connection two minutes after the switch), still_on_ivora (a connection to Ivora is still open, also while applied_socket_open), superseded (the charger was moved to Ivora again since), unknown (no proxy report since the switch). Null when failed, superseded or expired.

requested_by.title: Requested By
requested_by.description: Who asked for it: user:<id>, key:<id> or app:<id>.

source.title: Source
source.description: tenant: the project's own administrators; ivora: Ivora staff.

rolled_back_at.title: Rolled Back At
rolled_back_at.description: When the proxy switched the route (its own clock), once applied.

settled_at.title: Settled At
settled_at.description: When Ivora recorded the current status (the proxy's result, the socket closing, the supersession or the expiry).

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: The proxy's note on the result, such as why it failed.

migration_id.title: Migration Id
migration_id.description: The migration workspace of the station (/v1/migrations/{migration_id}), when it is in one.

revision.title: Revision
revision.description: Pass as after_revision on the next poll.

requests.title: Requests
requests.description: Open requests newer than after_revision, oldest first.

desired.title: Desired
desired.description: With after_revision=0 only: every migration charger with a route asked for.

request_id.title: Request Id
request_id.description: The request this reports on; null for the charger's current state or a change made on the proxy itself (break-glass).

current.title: Current
current.description: Where the proxy routes the charger now.

outcome.title: Outcome
outcome.description: With request_id: the proxy's result (exit 0 or 6: applied, 4: applied with a socket to Ivora still open (connected lists ivora), 2: refused_busy, 7: refused_parity, 3/5: failed).

at.title: At
at.description: When the route changed, by the proxy's clock (ISO 8601 with offset).

connected.title: Connected
connected.description: The sides a connection of the charger is open on now.

detail.title: Detail
detail.description: A short note. Never a credential.

require_idle.title: Require Idle
require_idle.description: false for a rollback: applied at once, also while charging.

match.title: Match
match.description: The charger's match (model_profile.match), beside every suggestion

source_class.title: Source Class
source_class.description: Where the profile's layout comes from: the maker's public documents, or an Ivora lab run

applied.title: Applied
applied.description: Fields the dry run wrote from the profile (autofill=apply); the source left each of them empty

suggestions.title: Suggestions
suggestions.description: Fields the source leaves empty that the profile knows; nothing is written for them

suggested_layout.title: Suggested Layout
suggested_layout.description: For a charger whose CSV rows lack evse_number or connector_type (an error row): the profile's connectors, one per CSV row to write

label.title: Label
label.description: The charger proxy's name, also on its route reports.

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: The credential's first characters, to recognise it; never the secret.

last_seen_at.title: Last Seen At
last_seen_at.description: Its last heartbeat, route poll or report.

healthy.title: Healthy
healthy.description: Seen within the last 60 seconds and not revoked.

last_revision.title: Last Revision
last_revision.description: The last route revision it pulled.

heartbeat.title: Heartbeat
heartbeat.description: Its last heartbeat body: nodes, upstreams, routed and connected counts.

label.title: Label
label.description: The charger proxy's name, also on its route reports.

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: The credential's first characters, to recognise it; never the secret.

last_seen_at.title: Last Seen At
last_seen_at.description: Its last heartbeat, route poll or report.

healthy.title: Healthy
healthy.description: Seen within the last 60 seconds and not revoked.

last_revision.title: Last Revision
last_revision.description: The last route revision it pulled.

heartbeat.title: Heartbeat
heartbeat.description: Its last heartbeat body: nodes, upstreams, routed and connected counts.

credential.title: Credential
credential.description: The runner credential, shown once: store it on the proxy host only. It is accepted on this migration's runner routes and nowhere else.

label.title: Label
label.description: The charger proxy's name (its site), for example example-cpo-site-1.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Send the running and final cost of this station's bills to the charger screen (California CTEP). On by default; an explicit choice always wins over the default.

interval_seconds.title: Interval Seconds
interval_seconds.description: Least time between two running cost messages of one session; a message goes out only when energy or cost changed.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Whether this station's bills get running cost messages: the explicit choice, else this environment's default (on; capabilities running_cost.default).

source.title: Source
source.description: default: no explicit choice, enabled follows the environment's default. manual: set by PUT (updated_by, updated_at) and kept until changed.

updated_by.title: Updated By
updated_by.description: Who wrote the explicit choice (user: or key:); null for the default.

support.title: Support
support.description: ocpp16_costmsg: OCA California Pricing DataTransfer (org.openchargealliance.costmsg RunningCost and FinalCost). ocpp16_no_costmsg: the charger's own configuration was read and reports no CustomDisplayCostAndPrice (display-pricing level price_text or none), so it gets no cost messages. ocpp2_cost_updated: CostUpdated during the session. ocpp2_deferred: OCPP 2.x cost messages are switched off in this environment while the charging core sends its own. charger_rejected: the OCPP 1.6 charger answered RunningCost with UnknownVendorId, UnknownMessageId or Rejected (see rejection); nothing is sent until it reboots or the setting is written. not_booted: the charger has not reported its protocol yet.

rejection.description: The charger's refusal while support is charger_rejected, else null.

updated_at.title: Updated At
updated_at.description: When the explicit choice was last changed; null for the default.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.description: The 20 most recent priced sessions on this station, newest first; null without billing:read.

status.title: Status
status.description: The charger's DataTransfer.conf status.

at.title: At
at.description: When the charging core received the refusal.

state.title: State
state.description: running: running cost messages are being sent. final_pending: the session ended and its final cost is being sent (OCPP 1.6). final_sent: the charging core accepted the final cost message. final_rejected: the charger refused the final cost (last_error final_cost_rejected; some chargers refuse it once the transaction has stopped); the station and its later sessions are unaffected. final_by_core: OCPP 2.x carries the final cost in the core's TransactionEvent response. deferred: OCPP 2.x CostUpdated is switched off in this environment. expired: the final cost could not be sent within an hour of the end. failed: the bill could not be priced or matched; last_error has the code.

cost_minor.title: Cost Minor
cost_minor.description: Latest running cost in minor units: energy × the bill's rate, as bill finalization rounds it.

energy_wh.title: Energy Wh
energy_wh.description: Session energy in Wh at cost_minor.

sent_cost_minor.title: Sent Cost Minor
sent_cost_minor.description: Running cost in minor units the core last accepted.

sends.title: Sends
sends.description: Running cost messages the core accepted for this session.

final_minor.title: Final Minor
final_minor.description: Final cost in minor units: the final bill's total, or the same calculation from the ended transaction.

last_error.title: Last Error
last_error.description: Error code of the last failed or withheld send, for example dispatch_unconfirmed, station_offline, charger_rejected or final_cost_rejected.

measurand.title: Measurand
measurand.description: OCPP measurand; Energy.Active.Import.Register when the charger omitted it (the OCPP default).

value.title: Value
value.description: The value as the charger reported it, as decimal text, before multiplier.

unit.title: Unit
unit.description: Unit of value; Wh when the charger omitted it (the OCPP default).

multiplier.title: Multiplier
multiplier.description: Power of ten value is multiplied by (OCPP 2.x unitOfMeasure.multiplier; 0 on OCPP 1.6).

context.title: Context
context.description: Reading context; Sample.Periodic when the charger omitted it (the OCPP default).

value_wh.title: Value Wh
value_wh.description: Energy register measurands in Wh or kWh: the reading in integer Wh, multiplier applied. Null otherwise.

location_ids.title: Location Ids
location_ids.description: The sites the team sees and acts on: the migration's chargers at these locations only.

sensitive.title: Sensitive
sensitive.description: True where the app could act on chargers or money: it needs your explicit consent and is rate limited per install.

source.title: Source
source.description: The message the result came in: Authorize (a card at the reader, or a remote start with AuthorizeRemoteTxRequests), StartTransaction.conf, or a StopTransaction by the transaction's own card.

id_tag.title: Id Tag
id_tag.description: In full when this lease's user typed the card, else its last 4 characters behind ****.

typed.title: Typed
typed.description: The card is one this lease's user typed (POST .../rfid).

status.title: Status
status.description: idTagInfo.status: Accepted, Blocked, Expired, Invalid or ConcurrentTx (CallError: the target answered an error); null for a stop by the transaction's own card (a charger asks nothing).

outcome.title: Outcome
outcome.description: awaiting_plug_in: Accepted before the EV was plugged in (plug in before plug_in_by); plug_in_timed_out; started; stopping / stopped: a card with the transaction's parentIdTag, or the same card, stops it; not_owner: Accepted, but another card's transaction is running and the parentIdTag differs, so nothing stops; refused: not Accepted.

plug_in_by.title: Plug In By
plug_in_by.description: For awaiting_plug_in: the end of the charger's ConnectionTimeOut.

state.title: State
state.description: connecting until the target accepted the charger; refused with reason (http 401, tls..., target_timeout) while the charger retries; offline when the charger cannot be read; released once the lease ended (reason: why).

charger_ocpp.title: Charger Ocpp
charger_ocpp.description: The charger's own OCPP connection status (EVerest), e.g. connected.

status.title: Status
status.description: The OCPP 1.6 status: the charger's last StatusNotification (status_source status_notification, read by the relay), else the one its EVSE state implies (status_source evse_state).

evse_state.title: Evse State
evse_state.description: EVerest's EVSE state: Unplugged, AuthRequired, Charging, Finished...

url.title: Url
url.description: The QR / checkout URL the target pushed (credential-looking query values redacted).

charger_answer.title: Charger Answer
charger_answer.description: What the charger answered: Accepted, UnknownVendorId, UnknownMessageId, Rejected... (EVerest accepts the OCA California Pricing messages; other vendors' display messages are answered as unknown, as a charger without that adapter would).

id.title: Id
id.description: The transactionId the target system gave in StartTransaction.conf.

stop_reason.title: Stop Reason
stop_reason.description: The StopTransaction reason the charger sent: Local (stop button), EVDisconnected (unplug), Remote...

id_tag.title: Id Tag
id_tag.description: The card that started it: in full when this lease's user typed it, else its last 4 characters behind ****.

parent_id_tag.title: Parent Id Tag
parent_id_tag.description: The parentIdTag the target answered in StartTransaction.conf, masked.

started_by.title: Started By
started_by.description: remote_start: the target's RemoteStartTransaction for the same card; local: a card at the reader.

stop_id_tag.title: Stop Id Tag
stop_id_tag.description: The card in the StopTransaction (a card tapped to stop it), shown as id_tag.

stopped_by.title: Stopped By
stopped_by.description: Which card stopped it: the same card again, or another one with the same parentIdTag.

trial_enabled.title: Trial Enabled
trial_enabled.description: Whether new teams may enable CSMS access themselves here now. Teams already in the trial keep their limits either way.

state.title: State
state.description: active: CSMS access is on, with the charger cap, review-gated features and rate limits. waitlisted: the trial is full; the team waits in order (waitlist_position). reviewed: Ivora reviewed the team and lifted the cap and gates. suspended: Ivora turned its CSMS access off. null: the team never enrolled.

card_ok.title: Card Ok
card_ok.description: Whether the team has a usable card on file (billing status active: not expired, nothing overdue, not suspended).

billing_status.title: Billing Status
billing_status.description: The team's usage-fee status, as the billing profile's status.

waitlist_position.title: Waitlist Position
waitlist_position.description: 1 for the next team to join, while waitlisted.

charger_cap.title: Charger Cap
charger_cap.description: Stations the team may have across its projects until Ivora reviews it; null when not capped.

chargers.title: Chargers
chargers.description: Stations the team has now (counted up to one past the cap), while capped; null otherwise or when the charging core could not be read.

review_gated.title: Review Gated
review_gated.description: Features that wait for Ivora's review while the team is capped: ocpi_publish, ocpp_domain, payment_domain, qr_domain, enterprise_invoicing, migration.

team_limit.title: Team Limit
team_limit.description: Teams the trial takes; later ones are waitlisted.

slots_used.title: Slots Used
slots_used.description: Teams that took a place in the trial so far (active, reviewed and suspended).

outcome.title: Outcome
outcome.description: enabled: CSMS access is on now. waitlisted: the trial is full and the team joined its waitlist. unchanged: nothing changed (already enabled, reviewed, suspended or still waiting).

trial_enabled.title: Trial Enabled
trial_enabled.description: Whether new teams may enable CSMS access themselves here now. Teams already in the trial keep their limits either way.

state.title: State
state.description: active: CSMS access is on, with the charger cap, review-gated features and rate limits. waitlisted: the trial is full; the team waits in order (waitlist_position). reviewed: Ivora reviewed the team and lifted the cap and gates. suspended: Ivora turned its CSMS access off. null: the team never enrolled.

card_ok.title: Card Ok
card_ok.description: Whether the team has a usable card on file (billing status active: not expired, nothing overdue, not suspended).

billing_status.title: Billing Status
billing_status.description: The team's usage-fee status, as the billing profile's status.

waitlist_position.title: Waitlist Position
waitlist_position.description: 1 for the next team to join, while waitlisted.

charger_cap.title: Charger Cap
charger_cap.description: Stations the team may have across its projects until Ivora reviews it; null when not capped.

chargers.title: Chargers
chargers.description: Stations the team has now (counted up to one past the cap), while capped; null otherwise or when the charging core could not be read.

review_gated.title: Review Gated
review_gated.description: Features that wait for Ivora's review while the team is capped: ocpi_publish, ocpp_domain, payment_domain, qr_domain, enterprise_invoicing, migration.

team_limit.title: Team Limit
team_limit.description: Teams the trial takes; later ones are waitlisted.

slots_used.title: Slots Used
slots_used.description: Teams that took a place in the trial so far (active, reviewed and suspended).

note.title: Note
note.description: What you need reviewed, such as more chargers, OCPI publishing or a custom domain.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.description: Transactions that started in the period, active ones included.

ended_sessions.title: Ended Sessions
ended_sessions.description: Of those, the ones that have ended.

successful_sessions.title: Successful Sessions
successful_sessions.description: Ended sessions that delivered energy (at least 1 Wh) and did not stop for a fault, reset, power loss, timeout or deauthorization.

success_rate.title: Success Rate
success_rate.description: successful_sessions / ended_sessions as decimal text with 4 places ("0.9500"); null when no session ended.

average_duration_seconds.title: Average Duration Seconds
average_duration_seconds.description: Mean whole seconds from start to end over ended sessions; null when none ended.

energy_kwh.title: Energy Kwh
energy_kwh.description: Energy delivered in kWh as decimal text (the core's totalKwh, summed exactly).

energy_wh.title: Energy Wh
energy_wh.description: The same energy in integer Wh.

provider.title: Provider
provider.description: simulator authorizes at once; stripe opens a hosted checkout on the Stripe platform account where this environment allows test payments, never a live one.

target.description: Where the bench charger connects; the global endpoint when omitted. Other targets run a connection session: the charger connects there and you drive charging from that system.

energy_kwh.title: Energy Kwh
energy_kwh.description: Stop at this energy, in kWh: a decimal above 0 and at most 500, with at most 3 decimal places (1 Wh). A string such as "12.5" or a JSON number.

amount_minor.title: Amount Minor
amount_minor.description: Stop at this amount in minor units of the bill's currency (cents for USD and CAD), converted once to energy at the bill's per-kWh rate. Session, time and idle fees are not counted against it.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: With amount_minor: the bill's tariff currency, such as USD or CAD.

SessionLimit.title: SessionLimit
SessionLimit.description: Exactly one of energy_kwh, or amount_minor with currency.

energy_kwh.title: Energy Kwh
energy_kwh.description: The energy cap the platform enforces, in kWh; for an amount limit, the amount converted at rate_minor.

amount_minor.title: Amount Minor
amount_minor.description: Amount limits: the limit in minor units.

rate_minor.title: Rate Minor
rate_minor.description: Amount limits: the bill's per-kWh rate (minor units) the amount was converted at, with the per-kWh tax on bills whose prices exclude tax.

stop_reason.title: Stop Reason
stop_reason.description: limit_reached once the platform decided to stop the session at its limit.

stop_energy_kwh.title: Stop Energy Kwh
stop_energy_kwh.description: Energy delivered (kWh) when the platform decided to stop.

stop_operation.description: The latest stop the platform sent; succeeded means the charger route accepted it.

final_energy_kwh.title: Final Energy Kwh
final_energy_kwh.description: Final bills: the billed energy in kWh.

final_amount_minor.title: Final Amount Minor
final_amount_minor.description: Final bills: the billed total in minor units, including any fees.

overrun_kwh.title: Overrun Kwh
overrun_kwh.description: Final bills: final energy minus the energy cap, never below 0.

overrun_minor.title: Overrun Minor
overrun_minor.description: Final bills with an amount limit: final amount minus the limit, never below 0.

start_at.title: Start At
start_at.description: When charging starts, ISO 8601 with an offset.

time_zone.title: Time Zone
time_zone.description: IANA time zone for the tariff's local-time restrictions. Default: the tariff's time_zone, else start_at's offset.

duration_minutes.title: Duration Minutes
duration_minutes.description: Charging time in minutes (TIME is billed on it).

energy_kwh.title: Energy Kwh
energy_kwh.description: Total energy, kWh. Omit when energy_curve is given.

energy_curve.title: Energy Curve
energy_curve.description: Cumulative kWh at minutes into charging, ascending.

idle_minutes.title: Idle Minutes
idle_minutes.description: Minutes connected after charging ends (PARKING_TIME is billed on it).

power_kw.title: Power Kw
power_kw.description: Constant charging power for power restrictions, kW. Default: the energy curve's slope.

current_a.title: Current A
current_a.description: Charging current for current restrictions, A. Unknown matches no current-restricted element.

reservation_minutes.title: Reservation Minutes
reservation_minutes.description: Minutes reserved before charging starts (reservation elements price them).

reservation_expired.title: Reservation Expired
reservation_expired.description: The reservation expired unused: no charging; RESERVATION_EXPIRES elements apply.

group.title: Group
group.description: Member or RFID group, for group discounts.

id_token.title: Id Token
id_token.description: RFID or app token, for group discounts that list tokens. Not stored.

merchant_validation.title: Merchant Validation
merchant_validation.description: A merchant validation code, for the merchant validation rule.

prepaid_balance_minor.title: Prepaid Balance Minor
prepaid_balance_minor.description: A prepaid balance, for the prepaid_limit report.

SessionProfile.title: SessionProfile
SessionProfile.description:
A charging session to price. Energy is cumulative kWh: energy_kwh spreads evenly over duration_minutes, or
energy_curve gives it at points (linear between them).

status.title: Status
status.description: starting: the bill start was dispatched and no transaction matched yet. stopped: the transaction completed; settle next. operator_required: the bill could not be captured (last_error, for example bill_exceeds_hold); the charger is already released and Ivora staff settle it. Connection sessions (a target other than global): connecting, then connected, or connect_failed (target.error; the charger is restored to its default), and ended once canceled, idle or at its maximum age.

transaction_id.title: Transaction Id
transaction_id.description: Transaction resource ID of the real OCPP transaction.

energy_wh.title: Energy Wh
energy_wh.description: Integer Wh, derived once from the core's kWh.

energy_kwh.title: Energy Kwh
energy_kwh.description: Decimal kWh as the charging core stores it.

estimated_minor.title: Estimated Minor
estimated_minor.description: Bill estimate at the tariff rate; equals total_minor once final.

rate_minor.title: Rate Minor
rate_minor.description: Minor units per kWh, snapshotted from the bench tariff.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: ISO 4217 code of every amount here; the OCPP bench's tariff is USD.

running_cost.description: What the charger's own display shows; null when the charger cannot be read or the session holds no charger.

next_action.title: Next Action
next_action.description: Stripe: the hosted checkout to complete before charging starts.

target.description: Where the bench charger connects for this session.

id.title: Id
id.description: A target id from GET /v1/sessions/targets: global, project_url, domain:<domain id> or custom_url.

tenant_id.title: Tenant Id
tenant_id.description: The project whose address the charger uses; required except for global. On global, a dedicated bench tenant of this environment (staff: the CAD bench) makes a virtual charger lease that tenant's own charger; any other value is ignored there.

url.title: Url
url.description: custom_url only: ws:// or wss://, port 80, 443 or 8000-9999, no user name or password.

identity.title: Identity
identity.description: custom_url only: the OCPP identity the bench charger uses at that system, appended to the URL. Kept in memory for the lease only and shown masked.

password.title: Password
password.description: custom_url only: the Basic authentication password for that identity. Kept in memory for the lease only; never stored, logged or returned.

token.title: Token
token.description: A signed JWT for the app's UI. Verify it with the keys at /v1/apps/jwks.json; its audience is the app's id.

scope.title: Scope
scope.description: Space-separated scopes: the install's, within your current team role in the project.

install_id.title: Install Id
install_id.description: The install (the app in this project) the token is for.

scopes.title: Scopes
scopes.description: A subset of the scopes the install and your role allow; omit for all of them.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why it was not checked: no_baseline (no sessions in the baseline and no shadow-mode ledger entries in the window), too_many_sessions.

source.title: Source
source.description: baseline: the totals recorded from the previous platform; shadow_ledger: the sessions the charger proxy recorded from the control link in shadow mode (OCPP 1.6).

ivora.description: Ivora's sessions on the charger that started in the window (in shadow mode, its copy).

cdrs_held.title: Cdrs Held
cdrs_held.description: Sessions whose CDR waits for a decision; Ivora staff release them today.

rollback_sla.title: Rollback Sla
rollback_sla.description: An Ivora rollback commitment is in force (rollback by Ivora within 4 business hours). Ivora support stays on the migration either way.

rollback_window_days.title: Rollback Window Days
rollback_window_days.description: Days after a charger moved during which it can still be rolled back to the previous platform.

drain_per_second.title: Drain Per Second
drain_per_second.description: Socket closes per second when a rollback covers more than 50 chargers.

rollback_sla.title: Rollback Sla
rollback_sla.description: An Ivora rollback commitment is in force. Ivora support stays on the migration either way.

rollback_window_days.title: Rollback Window Days
rollback_window_days.description: Days after a charger moved during which it can still be rolled back to the previous platform, which keeps the charger registered meanwhile.

drain_per_second.title: Drain Per Second
drain_per_second.description: Socket closes per second when a rollback covers more than 50 chargers, so the previous platform is spared a reconnect storm. 50 chargers or fewer are never paced.

rollback_sla.title: Rollback Sla
rollback_sla.description: An Ivora rollback commitment is in force (rollback by Ivora within 4 business hours). false: no formal commitment. Either way Ivora support stays on the migration and Ivora administrators keep read access and emergency rollback.

changes.title: Changes
changes.description: [{switch, from, to}]: what would change against the version in force.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: sample_id, current, proposed and changes (the leaf fields that differ) of a real Location this partner receives.

cdrs.title: Cdrs
cdrs.description: The partner's newest CDR, if it has one.

retry.title: Retry
retry.description: The schedule: name, attempts and the waits in seconds.

version.title: Version
version.description: 0: the profile's defaults, nothing saved yet.

allowed.title: Allowed
allowed.description: Per switch the values this partner's profile offers; nothing else is accepted.

changed.title: Changed
changed.description: On a save: whether it made a new version (false: those values were already in force).

staff.title: Staff
staff.description: Saved by Ivora staff acting on the project.

changes.title: Changes
changes.description: [{switch, from, to}] against the version before.

operation_reference.title: Operation Reference
operation_reference.description: Stable processor operation ID. Reuse for outcome updates; use a new ID only for a distinct financial operation.

amount_minor.title: Amount Minor
amount_minor.description: Integer minor units of the bill's currency (cents for USD and CAD). Release uses zero. This reports a fact; it never moves money.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: The bill's currency; omit it to use the bill's. Any other currency returns 409 settlement_conflict.

url.title: Url
url.description: Stripe-hosted page that saves a card for the team without charging it; open it now.

expires_at.title: Expires At
expires_at.description: Unix time the setup page expires.

control_transaction_id.title: Control Transaction Id
control_transaction_id.description: The transactionId the controlling platform assigned; the charger uses it in MeterValues and StopTransaction.

copy_transaction_id.title: Copy Transaction Id
copy_transaction_id.description: The transactionId Ivora's core assigned on the copy link: the proxy rewrites the charger's control ID to it on that link.

energy_wh.title: Energy Wh
energy_wh.description: meter_stop_wh - meter_start_wh: the charger's registers, Wh; null until both are known.

copy_transaction_id.title: Copy Transaction Id
copy_transaction_id.description: The transactionId Ivora's core answered StartTransaction with on the copy link.

connector_id.title: Connector Id
connector_id.description: The OCPP 1.6 connectorId of the StartTransaction.

meter_start_wh.title: Meter Start Wh
meter_start_wh.description: StartTransaction meterStart: the charger's energy register in Wh, as sent.

control_status.title: Control Status
control_status.description: idTagInfo.status the controlling platform answered the StartTransaction with.

copy_status.title: Copy Status
copy_status.description: idTagInfo.status Ivora's core answered it with on the copy link.

stopped_at.title: Stopped At
stopped_at.description: The StopTransaction timestamp, once the session stopped.

meter_stop_wh.title: Meter Stop Wh
meter_stop_wh.description: StopTransaction meterStop: the charger's energy register in Wh, as sent.

stop_reason.title: Stop Reason
stop_reason.description: StopTransaction reason (Local when absent, per OCPP 1.6).

location_id.title: Location Id
location_id.description: Optional: a location of this tenant whose tax lines (PUT .../locations/{location_id}/tax) apply, as they will on a bill for a station there. Omit for the price before any location's tax.

evse_id.title: Evse Id
evse_id.description: The EVSE ID imported from the previous platform (eMI3, such as US*ABC*E123*1), else null.

connector_ids.title: Connector Ids
connector_ids.description: Connector resource IDs on this EVSE; charging sessions take them.

direction.title: Direction
direction.description: to_ivora: the site's chargers now connect to Ivora (site.flipped). to_previous_platform: they went back to the previous platform (site.flip_rolled_back).

station_ids.title: Station Ids
station_ids.description: The stations that moved, all at this location. Omit for every station at the location.

flipped_at.title: Flipped At
flipped_at.description: When the routing changed (ISO 8601 with offset); defaults to now.

flip_reference.title: Flip Reference
flip_reference.description: The migration tool's own identifier for this flip, repeated in the event.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why, for the event and the audit trail.

flip_id.title: Flip Id
flip_id.description: Ivora's identifier of this flip; replays of the request return the same one.

event_id.title: Event Id
event_id.description: The site.flipped or site.flip_rolled_back event recorded for it.

all_stations.title: All Stations
all_stations.description: true when every station at the location moved.

smart_charging.title: Smart Charging
smart_charging.description: Whether the charger reports smart charging available; null when it has not reported

units.title: Units
units.description: Units the charger accepts limits in; null when unreported

max_profiles.title: Max Profiles
max_profiles.description: Charging profiles the charger holds at once

purposes.title: Purposes
purposes.description: Profile purposes the API offers this charger

source.title: Source
source.description: OCPP 1.6 configuration keys or the OCPP 2.x device model the core recorded

reported.title: Reported
reported.description: Whether the charger reported any of these settings. Refresh with POST .../configuration/refresh

name.title: Name
name.description: Common Paper Cloud Service Agreement Standard Terms, or Common Paper DPA Standard Terms.

version.title: Version
version.description: The Common Paper Standard Terms version the cover page incorporates (2.1 for the Terms of Service, 1.1 for the DPA).

url.title: Url
url.description: Where Common Paper hosts this version of the Standard Terms. Link it next to the cover page.

attribution.title: Attribution
attribution.description: The attribution to show with the Standard Terms.

as_of.title: As Of
as_of.description: When the core was read (cached up to 30 seconds).

faulted.title: Faulted
faulted.description: Connected, with at least one connector whose last status is Faulted.

test.title: Test
test.description: Test stations (the OCPP bench's own station a virtual charger connects as), counted here only: never in total, online, offline or faulted.

shadow.title: Shadow
shadow.description: Stations in shadow mode now (another platform controls them while a site migrates), counted here only: never in total, online, offline or faulted.

last_seen.title: Last Seen
last_seen.description: Timestamp of the last OCPP message from this charger, if any.

latitude.title: Latitude
latitude.description: The station's own position, if set; else its location's applies.

evses.title: Evses
evses.description: The station's EVSEs; edit them under /evses/{evse_number}.

connection_url.title: Connection Url
connection_url.description: Default OCPP WebSocket URL for this station: the project URL for a per-project station while its project has per-project charger URLs, the global URL of its name with the charger_id appended while they are off, else the global URL of its name. Custom OCPP domains are in custom_connection_urls.

custom_connection_urls.title: Custom Connection Urls
custom_connection_urls.description: The station's URL on each ACTIVE custom OCPP domain of its project, empty without one. connection_url is unchanged.

connection_base_url.title: Connection Base Url
connection_base_url.description: For a charger that appends its own ID: the project URL to configure, such as wss://ocpp.ivoracharge.co/18/. Null for a station with a global name, or while its project's charger URLs are off.

connection_address.title: Connection Address
connection_address.description: Read-only. legacy_global: the station connects through the global csmsws address, which stays supported for chargers already registered on it. project: it connects at its project address (connection_base_url). New chargers use project addresses.

charger_id.title: Charger Id
charger_id.description: The charger's own OCPP identity in its project, for a station registered with charger_id; null for a station with a global name.

username.title: Username
username.description: The Basic authentication username the charger sends: its charger_id, else name.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Your own key/value pairs (strings), such as a site host or a contract ID: at most 50 keys of 1-40 characters of A-Z, a-z, 0-9, underscore, period and hyphen, values of at most 500 characters. Never secrets or personal data. Never published to OCPI roaming partners.

display.description: Whether Ivora can drive this charger's screen, and the configured displays.

display_adapter.description: For a payable station (a connector with a tariff) that has booted: whether a display adapter puts the payment QR and price on its screen. Null for a station without tariffs or before the charger's first boot.

open_faults.title: Open Faults
open_faults.description: Faults still open, from the charger's status notifications; history at /faults.

shadow.title: Shadow
shadow.description: Shadow mode: another platform controls this station while Ivora receives a copy of its traffic. Ivora sends it nothing (commands, configuration, passwords, charging profiles and displays answer 409 station_shadow), bills nothing on it and keeps its sessions out of usage fees, webhooks, OCPI and statistics. Ivora staff set it while a site migrates.

decommissioned.title: Decommissioned
decommissioned.description: Decommissioned by the owner: the charger is dropped for good. Monitoring, alerts and charger events skip it, so its being offline or refused is expected, and it takes no new sessions (409 station_decommissioned). Set with POST .../decommission; the station and its history stay.

warnings.title: Warnings
warnings.description: Only on the first response to a registration that replaces a global station of the same charger name: differences from its layout and tariffs, or that it could not be read. Empty otherwise.

name.title: Name
name.description: The station's OCPP connection name.

decommissioned.title: Decommissioned
decommissioned.description: Whether the station is decommissioned after this request.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: The recorded reason; null once recommissioned.

decommissioned_by.title: Decommissioned By
decommissioned_by.description: Who decommissioned it (key:<id>, user:<id> or app:<id>); null once recommissioned.

changed.title: Changed
changed.description: false when the request changed nothing: the station was already decommissioned (the first record is kept) or, on DELETE, was not. No webhook is sent then.

name.title: Name
name.description: The station's OCPP connection name (name in station reads), as a confirmation; refused with 409 station_name_mismatch when it is another one (details.name), so a wrong station ID never decommissions another charger.

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why, for the record: kept with the flag, in the audit log and in station.decommissioned.

adapter.title: Adapter
adapter.description: Display adapter template that drives this charger's screen, or null when none applies.

qr.title: Qr
qr.description: The adapter sends the payment QR to the charger's screen. The generic OCPP 2.x adapters cannot tell whether the charger has a screen, so keep a printed QR.

price.title: Price
price.description: The adapter also sends a price: the display's tariff_id, else the connector tariff.

clear.title: Clear
clear.description: The adapter can take a QR off the screen. When false the QR can stay, even after a DELETE: until the charger reboots on RCD/Renova, until it is overwritten on Sinexcel (its configuration keys persist).

evses.title: Evses
evses.description: Configured displays and their delivery state; manage them under /evses/{evse_number}/display.

name.title: Name
name.description: Globally unique OCPP connection name; the charger connects at <connection_url>. Supply name or charger_id. Once the global charger URL is closed to new registrations in an environment, name answers 409 global_charger_url_retired: register with charger_id.

charger_id.title: Charger Id
charger_id.description: The charger's own OCPP identity, unique within this project. Per-project charger URLs are on by default where offered (409 project_urls_disabled where they are off for the project or not offered). The charger connects at connection_url, or appends this ID to connection_base_url, and uses it as its Basic authentication username. At most 36 characters together with p<tenant_id>-, for example 31 for tenant 18.

external_reference.title: External Reference
external_reference.description: Your stable identifier for this resource (for example a property or listing ID). Unique per tenant and resource type. Filter lists with ?external_reference=. No customer data or secrets.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Your own key/value pairs (strings), such as a site host or a contract ID: at most 50 keys of 1-40 characters of A-Z, a-z, 0-9, underscore, period and hyphen, values of at most 500 characters. Never secrets or personal data. Never published to OCPI roaming partners. On create, sets the pairs; on PATCH, merges them into the stored ones: a key sent as "" or null is deleted, other keys keep their values.

last_seen.title: Last Seen
last_seen.description: Timestamp of the last OCPP message from this charger, if any.

latitude.title: Latitude
latitude.description: The station's own position, if set; else its location's applies.

evses.title: Evses
evses.description: The station's EVSEs; edit them under /evses/{evse_number}.

connection_url.title: Connection Url
connection_url.description: Default OCPP WebSocket URL for this station: the project URL for a per-project station while its project has per-project charger URLs, the global URL of its name with the charger_id appended while they are off, else the global URL of its name. Custom OCPP domains are in custom_connection_urls.

custom_connection_urls.title: Custom Connection Urls
custom_connection_urls.description: The station's URL on each ACTIVE custom OCPP domain of its project, empty without one. connection_url is unchanged.

connection_base_url.title: Connection Base Url
connection_base_url.description: For a charger that appends its own ID: the project URL to configure, such as wss://ocpp.ivoracharge.co/18/. Null for a station with a global name, or while its project's charger URLs are off.

connection_address.title: Connection Address
connection_address.description: Read-only. legacy_global: the station connects through the global csmsws address, which stays supported for chargers already registered on it. project: it connects at its project address (connection_base_url). New chargers use project addresses.

charger_id.title: Charger Id
charger_id.description: The charger's own OCPP identity in its project, for a station registered with charger_id; null for a station with a global name.

username.title: Username
username.description: The Basic authentication username the charger sends: its charger_id, else name.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Your own key/value pairs (strings), such as a site host or a contract ID: at most 50 keys of 1-40 characters of A-Z, a-z, 0-9, underscore, period and hyphen, values of at most 500 characters. Never secrets or personal data. Never published to OCPI roaming partners.

display.description: Whether Ivora can drive this charger's screen, and the configured displays.

display_adapter.description: For a payable station (a connector with a tariff) that has booted: whether a display adapter puts the payment QR and price on its screen. Null for a station without tariffs or before the charger's first boot.

open_faults.title: Open Faults
open_faults.description: Faults still open, from the charger's status notifications; history at /faults.

shadow.title: Shadow
shadow.description: Shadow mode: another platform controls this station while Ivora receives a copy of its traffic. Ivora sends it nothing (commands, configuration, passwords, charging profiles and displays answer 409 station_shadow), bills nothing on it and keeps its sessions out of usage fees, webhooks, OCPI and statistics. Ivora staff set it while a site migrates.

decommissioned.title: Decommissioned
decommissioned.description: Decommissioned by the owner: the charger is dropped for good. Monitoring, alerts and charger events skip it, so its being offline or refused is expected, and it takes no new sessions (409 station_decommissioned). Set with POST .../decommission; the station and its history stay.

name.title: Name
name.description: New OCPP connection name, only before the charger first connects (409 station_connected afterwards): the charger connects at the new connection_url.

charger_id.title: Charger Id
charger_id.description: New per-project charger ID instead of a name, under the same rule; the project needs per-project charger URLs.

location_id.title: Location Id
location_id.description: Move the station to another location of this tenant.

floor_level.title: Floor Level
floor_level.description: Level the station is on, for example 2 or -1 (OCPI floor_level).

latitude.title: Latitude
latitude.description: The station's own position, when it differs from its location's; supply latitude and longitude together.

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Your own key/value pairs (strings), such as a site host or a contract ID: at most 50 keys of 1-40 characters of A-Z, a-z, 0-9, underscore, period and hyphen, values of at most 500 characters. Never secrets or personal data. Never published to OCPI roaming partners. On create, sets the pairs; on PATCH, merges them into the stored ones: a key sent as "" or null is deleted, other keys keep their values.

StationUpdate.title: StationUpdate
StationUpdate.description: Only the supplied fields change. vendor, model and serial come from the charger's BootNotification and are read-only.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.description: Transactions that started in the period, active ones included.

ended_sessions.title: Ended Sessions
ended_sessions.description: Of those, the ones that have ended.

successful_sessions.title: Successful Sessions
successful_sessions.description: Ended sessions that delivered energy (at least 1 Wh) and did not stop for a fault, reset, power loss, timeout or deauthorization.

success_rate.title: Success Rate
success_rate.description: successful_sessions / ended_sessions as decimal text with 4 places ("0.9500"); null when no session ended.

average_duration_seconds.title: Average Duration Seconds
average_duration_seconds.description: Mean whole seconds from start to end over ended sessions; null when none ended.

energy_kwh.title: Energy Kwh
energy_kwh.description: Energy delivered in kWh as decimal text (the core's totalKwh, summed exactly).

energy_wh.title: Energy Wh
energy_wh.description: The same energy in integer Wh.

start.title: Start
start.description: Bucket start, ISO 8601 in the requested time_zone.

end.title: End

revenue.title: Revenue
revenue.description: Final bills finalized in the bucket, per currency; null without billing:read.

time_zone.title: Time Zone
time_zone.description: IANA time zone that day and month buckets follow.

start.title: Start
start.description: The period's start: from, rounded down to a bucket boundary.

end.title: End
end.description: The period's end (exclusive): to, rounded up to a bucket boundary.

sessions_as_of.title: Sessions As Of
sessions_as_of.description: When the session figures were read from the core (cached 60 s for hour, 5 min for day, 15 min for month buckets).

series.title: Series
series.description: One entry per bucket, oldest first, empty buckets included. Sessions count in the bucket they started in.

top_stations.title: Top Stations
top_stations.description: Stations with the most energy over the period, most first (ties by station_id).

stations.description: Station state now, not for the period.

revenue.description: The period's revenue; null without billing:read.

test.description: Test sessions (virtual chargers on a test station), labelled apart: never in totals, series, top_stations or revenue, never billed; null when the period has none.

shadow.description: Shadow sessions (they started while their station was in shadow mode, controlled and billed by another platform), labelled apart: never in totals, series, top_stations or revenue; null when the period has none.

active_sessions.title: Active Sessions
active_sessions.description: Sessions of the period still active.

energy_unknown_sessions.title: Energy Unknown Sessions
energy_unknown_sessions.description: Sessions whose energy is missing or implausible (negative or above 1000 kWh); their energy is not summed.

format.title: Format
format.description: csv: a header line, then one sticker per line (see the QR redirect guide).

content.title: Content
content.description: The file's text (UTF-8), at most 5,000 stickers.

replace.title: Replace
replace.description: Remove the project's stickers the file does not name.

dry_run.title: Dry Run
dry_run.description: Validate and count only; nothing is stored.

code.title: Code
code.description: The sticker's code: its old path (and query), a code, or a charger ID. Matched regardless of case.

evse_number.title: Evse Number
evse_number.description: null: the charger's only EVSE, or a choice page when it has several.

modules.title: Modules
modules.description: Which of the profile's modules the connection carries.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.description: Per module (locations, tariffs, sessions, cdrs): push, or pull when the partner reads it from Ivora and Ivora sends nothing. Pulls are always answered.

tariff_display.title: Tariff Display
tariff_display.description: standard, no_alt_text, or price_summary. Never changes a price.

cdr_rounding.title: Cdr Rounding
cdr_rounding.description: exact, energy_3dp, time_minutes or energy_3dp_time_minutes: how the CDR's energy (kWh) and time (hours) are shown. Amounts are never rounded again.

retry.title: Retry
retry.description: standard, short or patient: the schedule of a push's attempts.

SwitchInput.title: SwitchInput
SwitchInput.description:
The switches a project may change on a partner (only those sent change). Every value is a name from the partner's profile: a
value outside it is refused (422 ocpi_switch_not_allowed), and there is no field for a transform, expression, template or script.

version.title: Version
version.description: The version whose values are restored as a new version.

expected_version.title: Expected Version
expected_version.description: The version you read; a newer one is refused.

expected_version.title: Expected Version
expected_version.description: The version you read. A newer one is refused (409 ocpi_settings_changed) so you do not overwrite a colleague's change.

custom_url_notice.title: Custom Url Notice
custom_url_notice.description: Shown before a custom URL is used.

custom_url_ws_warning.title: Custom Url Ws Warning
custom_url_ws_warning.description: Shown when a typed custom URL starts with ws://.

url.title: Url
url.description: The address the charger connects at; null for custom_url (typed by the caller).

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why the target is not available to you now.

id.title: Id
id.description: global, project_url, domain:<id> or custom_url.

tenant_id.title: Tenant Id
tenant_id.description: The project whose address was used (null for global).

url.title: Url
url.description: The address used, without credentials; a custom URL's identity is masked.

resolved_ip.title: Resolved Ip
resolved_ip.description: The address the connection was pinned to.

station_id.title: Station Id
station_id.description: project_url and domain: the bench's station in the project (p<project>-ivora-bench).

identity.title: Identity
identity.description: The OCPP identity used, masked for custom URLs.

password.title: Password
password.description: Always masked (••••••••) when one was supplied; null otherwise.

status.title: Status
status.description: connecting until the charger connected at the target; failed with error; resetting while the charger is factory reset after the lease; restored once it is back on its default.

error.title: Error
error.description: Why the connection failed: tcp, tls, http <status> or target_timeout.

warning.title: Warning
warning.description: A custom ws:// URL: the identity and password travel unencrypted.

rate_minor_per_kwh.title: Rate Minor Per Kwh
rate_minor_per_kwh.description: Integer minor units of currency per kWh. Tariffs created elsewhere with sub-cent rates return a decimal number.

rate_minor_per_minute.title: Rate Minor Per Minute
rate_minor_per_minute.description: Minor units per minute, or null. The simple fields are kWh-only: a simple tariff bills rate_minor_per_kwh × kWh and no time or session fee, so only 0 is accepted (and stored as 0); a non-zero value returns 422. Price charging time, idle time or a session fee with elements (TIME, PARKING_TIME, FLAT). Tariffs created elsewhere may still carry one, which is returned unchanged and not billed.

session_fee_minor.title: Session Fee Minor
session_fee_minor.description: Minor units per session, or null. elements.description: API version 2026-10-15 and later: the OCPI 2.2.1-aligned blocks billing uses; a simple tariff shows its one ENERGY block.

payment_mode.title: Payment Mode

projects.title: Projects

id_token.title: Id Token
id_token.description: The card's idTag (OCPP 1.6) or idToken (OCPP 2.0.1): 1-36 printable ASCII characters without spaces. Unique per tenant regardless of case or type, because the core matches an OCPP 1.6 idTag case-insensitively without a type. Values of the form iv + 18 hex digits, remotestart-<n> or PAY_<n> are reserved for payment flow charging tokens. Immutable: a new card is a new token.

type.title: Type
type.description: OCPP 2.0.1 IdTokenEnumType: ISO14443 for RFID cards. OCPP 1.6 chargers send no type, so it does not affect them. An ISO14443 value is 8 or 14 hex digits and an ISO15693 value 16, as the charging core checks at an OCPP 2.0.1 authorization (token_format_invalid); register other values as Central.

Never secrets or personal data. Never published to OCPI roaming partners. On create, sets the pairs; on PATCH, merges them into the stored ones: a key sent as "" or null is deleted, other keys keep their values.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: The limit inside the window, in the profile's unit; 0 pauses charging there

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Requests a minute the credential may make (a key's own limit, else 1,200). Calls with no recognised credential get 180 a minute per client address, except unauthenticated driver page and status calls, which get 1,200 a minute per client address. Calls that create a checkout or a payment (driver checkout creation, and payment creation) also count 30 a minute per client address (for a payment, the driver's X-Ivora-Driver-Address sent with a key or app Ivora registered for a driver checkout server) and 60 a minute per station; the headers then describe the tightest bucket.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests left in the current 60-second window.

X-RateLimit-Reset.description: Seconds until the oldest counted request leaves the window and room returns.

BadRequest.description: Bad request. Generic code: invalid_request. The request cannot be read as sent: malformed JSON, an Ivora-Version header naming no supported API version, or a list filter value the list does not accept (an unknown status, or an unreadable or inverted from/to time range). Correct the request. Omit Ivora-Version to use the key's pinned version. See [Errors and statuses](https://ivoracharge.co/developers/guides/reference/errors).

Unauthenticated.description: Unauthenticated. Generic code: unauthenticated. No bearer credential, or an API key or sign-in token that is invalid, revoked, expired or from another Ivora environment. Fix the credential; never loop on 401. See [Errors and statuses](https://ivoracharge.co/developers/guides/reference/errors).

PaymentMethodRequired.description: Payment required. Generic code: payment_method_required. The usage-fee gate on new CSMS setup and control refused the request: the project's billing team has no usable payment method or an unpaid invoice (payment_method_required), or Ivora suspended the team (billing_suspended). The gate covers creating stations, locations and CSMS keys, commands other than stop and unlock, setting or clearing charging profiles and session caps, and creating bills and external sessions. Reads, OCPP traffic, running charging, stops and continuing a bill or session that already exists are never refused. payment_method_required: a signed-in team owner, admin or billing member adds the team's card or pays the invoice; read the project's billing profile (details.billing_profile). billing_suspended: contact Ivora. See [Errors and statuses](https://ivoracharge.co/developers/guides/reference/errors).

Forbidden.description: Forbidden. Generic code: forbidden. The key or user lacks the scope, team role or tenant the operation requires (forbidden), a connected charger's password push needs stations:admin (stations_admin_required), or a configuration key is sensitive, protected or read-only. Use a key or sign-in with the scope the operation names (Requires …), or change what the request touches. See [Errors and statuses](https://ivoracharge.co/developers/guides/reference/errors).

NotFound.description: Not found. Generic code: not_found. The resource is absent or belongs to another tenant; the two are indistinguishable by design. Correct the identifier; list the collection to find it. See [Errors and statuses](https://ivoracharge.co/developers/guides/reference/errors).

Conflict.description: Conflict. Generic code: conflict. The resource's state forbids the request now: the charger is online or offline (station_online, station_offline), reports no smart charging (smart_charging_unsupported), the resource is in use or final, or the Idempotency-Key was used with different input (idempotency_key_reused), or earlier work on the same thing is still running (request_in_progress). Resolve the state the code names (disconnect, stop, delete dependents, release a lease), then send a new request. See [Errors and statuses](https://ivoracharge.co/developers/guides/reference/errors).

Unprocessable.description: Unprocessable. Generic code: invalid_request. The input fails validation (invalid_request, with each field and rule in the message), names something the charger reported it cannot take (charging_profile_unsupported: details.field, details.supported), or breaks a rule of the resource (details.errors for tariffs and templates). Correct the input the code and details name. See [Errors and statuses](https://ivoracharge.co/developers/guides/reference/errors).

TooManyRequests.description: Too many requests. Generic code: rate_limited. The per-minute request limit of the key or caller (rate_limited), a station's password changes in the last hour (credentials_rate_limited) or a limit of the OCPP bench. Back off; do not retry before Retry-After. See [Errors and statuses](https://ivoracharge.co/developers/guides/reference/errors).

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before retrying: the time until the rate limit window has room.

BadGateway.description: Bad gateway. Generic code: provider_error. A dependency or the charger answered with an error or did not confirm (provider_error, csms_request_failed, dispatch_unconfirmed, password_unconfirmed, password_not_stored). Treat a write as uncertain: read the operation or the resource first. See [Errors and statuses](https://ivoracharge.co/developers/guides/reference/errors).

ServiceUnavailable.description: Service unavailable. Generic code: temporarily_unavailable. A dependency is unreachable or the outcome is unknown (temporarily_unavailable, csms_unavailable, outcome_unknown with details.operation_id), or the environment lacks a service (stripe_not_configured) or its OCPP bench chargers are offline (bench_offline). Read the operation or resource; retry later. See [Errors and statuses](https://ivoracharge.co/developers/guides/reference/errors).
